articleTitle: New Energy Wind Power Development Status and Future Trends
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: In order to better understand development status of wind power generation in various countries in the world and provide a reference for future research, first introduced the current development status of wind power, including the newly added offshore wind power, cumulative installed capacity, and onshore wind power newly added and cumulative Installed capacity; then introduced and analyzed the current difficulties in wind power generation; finally analyzed the development prospects of wind power, focusing on the future development trend of wind power. The research results show that wind power has broad development prospects and will develop in the direction of large-scale in the near future.

articleTitle: Temperature Field Simulation and Ampacity Optimization of 500kV HVDC Submarine Transmission Cable
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The HVDC submarine power cables have complex structure and needs extraordinary manufacture process requirements. The HVDC submarine cable in an offshore wind farm usually goes through multiple laying sections with different laying environment. And in some of the sections, the heat dissipation condition may be unfavorable. To improve the safety of the transmission line, it is obligatory to study the cable temperature field and ampacity of power cable under different laying conditions and find the bottleneck sections, together with the methods to improve the ampacity of these weak sections. A 500kV XLPE submarine power cable is taken as the study object, the finite element modeling (FEM) is used to study the electromagnetic thermal coupling model of the submarine cables laying in the soil without trench, in the tube with water flowing for the purpose of forced cooling at beach section is established respectively to study the temperature field and ampacities by using COMSOL Multiphysics software. The results indicate that, water circulating in the tube would affect the cable heat dissipation and significantly ampacity is increased. Moreover, it has been noted that when the water flow rate is 2.78 L/s in the tube, the ampacity of cable is optimum and by the implementation of this proposed model the ampacity can be increased up to 650A.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Tank Rupture Due to Internal Electrical Fault in Oil-filled Power Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: In recent years, oil-filled power transformer explosion accidents occur from time to time, and have caused serious effect to the power system. To analyze the cause of oil tank rupture, a new numerical simulation model is established to calculate internal pressure rise caused by arc fault, and stress field of the tank body. Based on theories of wave acoustics, thermodynamics and solid mechanics, the model describes bubble’s generation, propagation of pressure wave, and deformation of the transformer tank. The simulation results are in good agreement with accident phenomena, which can provide reference for the future accident prevention.

articleTitle: Analysis of Electrical Tree Growth and Partial Discharge Stagnation in Epoxy Resin
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The aging of electrical branch tree is an important cause for the degradation of the insulation performance of cable accessories. There are many studies on the electrical tree of epoxy modified materials, but there are few reports on the phenomenon of partial discharge (PD) stagnation of epoxy resin electrical tree. In this paper, an “integrated” epoxy resin needle-board model is made to produce electric tree. The effect of radius of curvature of the needle tips on electric tree is studied, include tree initial voltage, tree growth morphology, tree growth rate and partial discharge intermittent phenomena of electric tree. A set of experimental platform was built, and the detection sensitivity of partial discharge can reach 0.1pC. The test results show that: the larger the radius of curvature of the needle tip of the steel needle, the higher the tree initial voltage, and the higher the probability that it will develop into a vine-shaped electrical tree. The smaller the radius of curvature of the needle tip of the steel needle, the lower the tree initial voltage, and the greater the probability that it will develop into a branch-like electrical tree. The vine-shaped electrical tree has a partial discharge “stay period”, about ten minutes, while the branch-shaped electrical tree does not have a more obvious discharge stagnation phenomenon.

articleTitle: Weighted power network node importance evaluation based on node deletion method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: In order to improve fault tolerance and reliability of power grid, node importance of weighted power grid is evaluated based on node deletion method. The IEEE-24 system is simulated, and the corresponding program is written by MATLAB to calculate the ratio of the average weighted path length of nodes. Finally, it is proved that this method is more accurate to evaluate the dynamic security of power grid.

articleTitle: Feature analysis of overhead transmission line malfunction caused by wildfires in North China and relevant Preventive Measures
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Wildfires can cause the decrease of breakdown voltage of the air gap of overhead transmission line, which in turn cause the malfunction of overhead transmission line. This paper analyzes three reasons for the decrease of breakdown voltage of the air gap caused by wildfires, including high temperature, floating objects, electrons and ions in the flame. Based on these three factors, the air gap characteristics of the wildfires malfunction of the transmission line are divided into flame zone, ion zone and smoke zone. Furthermore, this paper analyzes the characteristics of transmission line malfunction caused by wildfires in North China, including the time distribution, combustion characteristics, wind speed and flashover path of malfunctions. In order to improve the ability to resist the wildfires, technical means and measures for preventing malfunction caused by wildfires are proposed, including strictly controlling the fire source around the transmission line corridor, removing the combustible material in time, and transferring the load of the transmission line reasonably. This work lays a foundation for improving the protection of overhead transmission lines against wildfire.

articleTitle: 3D Printing and Flashover Voltage Test of Polypropylene-based Dielectric Functionally Graded Insulator
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: In this paper, 3D printing technology is used to fabricate polypropylene-based functionally graded insulators with different gradient forms, and their insulation properties are tested. The composite material used to make dielectric functionally graded materials (d-FGM) insulator is composed of polypropylene (PP) matrix and TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> filler. We determined the d-FGM insulators with two different gradient distribution forms of discrete gradient and quasi-continuous gradient through simulation analysis, and fabricated them with the fused deposition modeling (FDM) 3D printer. Then, the flashover voltage of the functionally graded insulator was tested under 50Hz AC voltage in 0.4MPa SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> atmosphere. The results show that in these two schemes, the d-FGM insulator with quasi-continuous gradient distribution has more significant effect to improve the flashover voltage. This research provides important guidance for the design and manufacture of functionally graded materials (FGM) components with excellent surface flashover performance.

articleTitle: Development of Transformer Winding Fault Monitoring System Based on Vibration Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The signal emitted by the transformer vibration contains a wealth of operating status information, which can be used as an important means to enrich the abnormal condition detection of transformers. The article reveals the mechanism of transformer winding vibration generation by both theory and simulation, and simulates the vibration of transformer under three cases of winding loosening, winding deformation and insulation shedding. According to the results of theoretical research and simulation analysis, this article designs a set of online monitoring system of transformer winding mechanical fault based on abnormal vibration analysis with VMD algorithm as the core. Finally, the overall test of the fault diagnosis system is conducted in the laboratory environment: The VMD entropy value of the diagnosis system tends to be abnormal when unusual mechanical vibration occurs, which verifies the effectiveness of the transformer winding mechanical fault diagnosis system.

articleTitle: Analysis of Fire Spread in High Voltage Cable Trench under Different Cable Laying Modes
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: With the continuous development of the power system, high voltage cable channel is widely used in urban construction, and becomes an indispensable part of power grid construction. However, in recent years, frequent cable fire accidents have seriously affected the safe operation of power grid, resulting in huge economic losses and even casualties. The proper layered laying of cable trench can play an important role in restraining fire spread and reducing the risk of cable burning. Based on the fire simulation software, this paper establishes the fire simulation model of underground high-voltage cable trench in substation, analyzes the change of temperature field and gas distribution in high-voltage cable trench by simulating the fire spread trend of two common cable laying modes, and draws the following conclusions: four layer cable laying mode is better than five layer cable laying mode, and four layer cable laying mode is better after the fire The method can effectively slow down the spread of fire, lower toxic gas concentration and better temperature field stability. At the same time, the temperature field and the distribution of toxic gas concentration are also found to be stratified. These conclusions are of great significance to reduce the loss of cable fire and to ensure the safety of fire fighters after the disaster.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Corona Characteristics of Ball-Plate Electrode under High Humidity
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: In order to deeply study the corona problem of power fittings in high-humidity areas, an artificial humidity climate chamber was designed to conduct corona experiments on the ball-plate electrode under high humidity. During the experiments, the photon number of the ball electrode with different humidity and voltage was recorded by the ultraviolet imager. The corona initiation voltage experiments at relative humidity of 50%, 60%, 70%, 80%, 90% and 97% are conducted respectively. Under the high humidity condition of 97% with the condensing state, the corona initiation voltage experiment also was taken to compare with non-condensing state. Finally, the influence of each stage of the dewdrop development process on the electric field is analyzed through electric field simulation. The experimental results show that as the humidity gradually increases from 50% to 97%, the ball electrode’s corona initiation voltage drops from 97.5kV to 48kV decreasing of 50.7%. When the humidity is 97%, the corona initiation voltage of the ball electrode with condensation is 29.6% lower than that without condensation. Under the same voltage, the number of photons at the moment of the dew drop is the largest. In the electric field simulation analysis, as the accumulation degree of the dew drop increases, the distortion of the electric field increases, the electric field distortion is the most serious when the dew drops is consistent with the maximum number of photons in the experiment.

articleTitle: Gas-Insulated Switchgear (GIS) Equipment Mechanical Fault Detection Based on Feature Learning of Vibration Signal Images
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: GIS is one of most important power devices in power systems. However, much research focused on the partial discharge rather than the mechanical fault. In this paper, mechanical fault detection based on vibration signals were used. Firstly, vibration signals were collected on the surface of GIS equipment. Then vibration images were generated from the vibration signal sequences. A vibration images CNN (VI-CNN) mechanical fault detection model was used in this paper based on the vibration images. Finally, the VI-CNN model performed well during the test. The performance reveals that the method can be used in GIS monitoring system to detect the mechanical state of GIS.

articleTitle: Research on Insulator Defect Detection Method Based on Image Processing and Watershed Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Disc-shaped suspension insulators are widely used in substations and transmission and distribution lines of various voltage levels. Its main function is to achieve insulation and wire fixation in high-voltage overhead transmission and distribution lines. During operation, in a complicated environment such as pollution, temperature and humidity, insulator damage and chip-dropping failures often occur. The exploration of non-contact insulator defect detection methods has important theoretical significance and practical value. This paper takes the visible light image of suspended insulators as the research object. In this paper, the image region is extracted according to the shape and texture of the insulator, and according to the difference of computer vision parameters of various defects, an improved watershed algorithm is selected to realize the segmentation of the insulator image. Aiming at the possible defects such as breakage and chipping, this paper proposes the insulator defect detection criterion, so as to realize the automatic detection of the defect and the classification of the defect type. The research algorithm considers environmental factors and the efficiency and accuracy of algorithm feature extraction.

articleTitle: Contamination Characteristics of Superhydrophobic Coated Insulators in Natural Environment and Artificial Simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: In order to study the rule of contamination accumulation on the surface of insulators with superhydrophobic coating, the natural contamination accumulation characteristics of XP-160 disc type porcelain insulators with superhydrophobic coating, RTV coating and no coating were compared. Through the artificial simulation pollution test of spraying dust, controlling wind speed and rain rate (rain intensity), the surface pollution state of insulator was observed, and the salt density (ESDD) and ash density(NSDD) values of insulator surface were tested. Furthermore, the pollution characteristics of superhydrophobic coating insulator were studied and analyzed. The results show that the pollution of superhydrophobic coating insulator is lighter than that of RTV coating insulator, but heavier than that of porcelain insulator. The superhydrophobic type II coating with silicone rubber compound still has good hydrophobicity after being contaminated. When the wind speed is between 2 and 4 m/s, the pollution accumulation of superhydrophobic coating insulator decreases faster than that of RTV coating and porcelain insulator, indicating that the surface pollution of superhydrophobic coating is easier to be removed by wind. With the increase of rain intensity, the pollution on the surface of superhydrophobic coating is easier to be removed, and the pollution on the surface of superhydrophobic coating is quickly removed when the rain is increased to 0.25 mm/min.

articleTitle: Molecular Simulation of Adsorption Behavior of Water and Mineral Oil Molecule on Zeolite 3A and 4A
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Oil-paper insulation is the main insulation form of transformer. Excessive moisture content of oil-paper insulation will seriously affect the insulation characteristics. An online water removal system for transformer can continuously remove moisture from mineral oil by using zeolite’s selective adsorption of water molecule, however, there is a lack of research on the adsorption behavior of water molecule and mineral oil molecule on zeolite A. In this paper, molecular dynamic method was used to simulate the adsorption process of water molecule and mineral oil molecule on zeolite 3A and 4A, and the adsorption mechanism was revealed. The results show that both zeolite 3A and 4A attract water molecule and mineral oil molecule, the electrostatic attraction between zeolite A and water molecules, and van der Waals attraction between zeolite A and mineral oil molecule. Zeolite 4A adsorbs more water molecules than zeolite 3A, and its moisture absorption efficiency is better, so it is more suitable to be used as adsorbent for online oil-paper insulation moisture removal system.

articleTitle: Partial discharge detection online in XLPE cable using the optical fiber Mach-Zehnder interferometer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Partial discharge detection has been widely used in the condition evaluation of crosslinked polyethylene(XLPE) cables as it can find the internal defects of cables in advance. The traditional partial discharge detection is greatly affected by the on-site environmental interference, so its development and application are subject to certain restrictions. Fiber optic sensing technology is resistant to electromagnetic interference and has good prospects for development. In this paper, a partial discharge test platform of XLPE cable is built. A specimen of XLPE cable terminal containing airgap defects is produced, and 70 turns of polarization maintaining optical fiber are build-in the XLPE cable terminal as the fiber optic sensor. The defect is a cylindrical airgap with a bottom radius of 1.5 mm and a height of 2 mm, located in the main insulation of the cable. The PD detection by fiber optic Mach-Zehnder interferometer is compared and analyzed with that by high frequency current transformer(HFCT). The test results show that fiber optic Mach-Zehnder interferometer sensing can detect the partial discharge at 11 kV-15 kV of the specimen, which is consistent with the HFCT detection results. The partial discharge acoustic wave is composed of a series of pulsed waves of different frequencies. A large percentage of fiber optic signals are low frequency signals. The number of pulse waves in the fiber optic sensing signal increases as the degree of partial discharge rises. The research results show that optical fiber measurement of partial discharge is an effective method, which can be used to carry out partial discharge detection of XLPE cables.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis and Discharge Type Identification of Partial Discharge Pulse Parameters of Oil-Paper Insulation Based on Ultra-wideband
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The effective measurement frequency band of the traditional pulse current method is up to 1MHz, which causes the loss of the main energy frequency band information of the partial discharge pulse signal. In view of this, an ultra-wideband partial discharge pulse measurement system with an effective measurement frequency band of 30kHz-50MHz is designed. The system is used to measure the discharge signals of three types of oil-paper insulation defect models built under laboratory conditions, in order to obtain statistical characteristics that can characterize different types of partial discharge pulse parameters of oil-paper insulation. The results show that: the ultra-wideband partial discharge pulse measurement system can restore the original characteristics of the partial discharge waveform to a greater extent, which is conducive to the accurate analysis of the characteristics of the partial discharge pulse; the measured parameters of different types of partial discharge pulses have different statistical characteristics. Using discharge pulse rise time, fall time, 50% pulse width and 10% pulse width as input characteristic parameters to identify partial discharge types can achieve better results.

articleTitle: Construction of Knowledge Graph of Electrical Equipment Based on Sentence - BERT
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The construction of the indicator system of power equipment is the basic work of the state assessment of power equipment, which is of great significance to maintain the stable operation of the equipment, Constructing the knowledge graph of the evaluation indicator of power equipment can provide data support for the state evaluation of power equipment. First, extract the indicators of each component of the equipment, establish the relationship between the indicators and the components, and form the hierarchical structure of the indicator system; Secondly, due to differences in the expression of indicators based on different standards, the Sentence-BERT (SBERT) network is used for knowledge fusion to achieve continuous improvement and update of knowledge in the knowledge graph; Finally, the constructed knowledge graph of the evaluation indicator of power equipment was visualized on Neo4j and its application was analyzed.

articleTitle: Establishment and Application of V-I and R-I Characteristic Equations of MOV
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Metal oxide varistor (MOV) has been widely used in power equipment to prevent the damage of overvoltage or overcurrent due to its excellent nonlinear characteristics. However, how to clearly describe the nonlinear characteristics of MOV has always been difficulties in the research of MOV. The equation suitable for describing the nonlinear characteristic of MOV and a method for measuring the parameters of the equation are presented in this paper. The characteristic equation can correctly express the actual characteristics of MOV within the range of $2\sim 3$ orders of magnitude of current peak value change. In this paper, the measurement method of V-I and R-I characteristic equations of MOV is given by experiment. By comparing the voltage calculated by the equations with the measured value, the deviation is less than 3%, which proves the validity of the proposed characteristic equation. In addition, this paper introduces the application occasions and methods of the proposed characteristic equation.

articleTitle: Research on DC Series Arc Model in Photovoltaic System Based on the Cassie Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: In order to study the changes of macro current and voltage before and after the arc occurs, this paper proposes a photovoltaic DC series fault arc model based on the Cassie arc model. An arc fault model circuit topology of the two-stage photovoltaic grid-connected system is established, which includes the two-stage grid-connected system and the fault arc model. The former includes photovoltaic cell components, DC-DC conversion modules, DC-AC modules with inverter grid-connected control and filter circuits, and the latter includes the Cassie arc model and the Gaussian white noise module. The fault arc current obtained by the simulation of the model is analyzed in the time domain and the frequency domain, which is verified by comparison with the experimental data.

articleTitle: Research on Substation Equipment Rust Detection Method Based on Improved SSD
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: It is one of the important tasks to maintain the safe and stable operation of the power grid to discover equipment defects or hidden safety hazards in time through daily inspections and take necessary measures to deal with them. Currently, power grid companies are exploring intelligent substation inspection technology based on image recognition to reduce the work pressure of operation and maintenance personnel and improve the quality and efficiency of operation and maintenance. Metal corrosion is one of the most frequent appearance defects of substation equipment. In severe cases, it will cause problems such as overheating of the equipment and breakage of the joints. This paper proposes an improved object detection network based on image recognition technology. On the basis of the SSD algorithm, the ResNet network is used instead of the VGG network, and the attention mechanism is added. Experiments show that the algorithm can effectively identify the rusty area of the equipment. Applying this algorithm to the intelligent inspection work of substations will effectively improve the timeliness and accuracy of defect discovery.

articleTitle: Joint Analysis of Vibration Signals and Switching Sequence Features of A Vacuum On Load Tap Changer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Vibration measurement of transformer vacuum on-load tap changer (VOLTC) can reflect its mechanical condition. In this paper, the Savitzky-Golay filter is used to process the vibration signal generated by the vacuum on-load tap changer. According to the switching process and the structure of the diverter switch, the filtered signal is segmented, and the origination of each vibration signal is determined. The segments improve the accuracy of fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: An Optical Electric Field Sensor for AC and DC Electric Field Measuring
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The technology of electric field measurement is an important method to obtain the transient process of power system, such as the overvoltage caused by switching operation. The optical electric field sensor based on Pockels effect is non-contact measurement, which has better performance and more flexible application than the traditional methods. The electro-optic crystal is the key part of the sensor, and different kinds of crystal has different charge relaxation time constant, which causes problem when measures DC electric field. In this paper, an optical electric field sensor in type of common path interferometer with LiNbO3 crystal is proposed. The response characteristics of the sensor is verified by AC electric field under different waveforms and frequencies, and DC electric field. Experimental results show that the proposed sensor can be used to measure both AC and DC electric field. The waveform of transient overvoltage recorded in UHV AC and DC substation are employed to test the performance of the sensor to real application scenario, and the results indicate good performance of the sensor.

articleTitle: Simulation of Propagation Pattern of Partial Discharge’s Ultrasonic Signal in Oil-Immersed Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The breakdown of insulation caused by partial discharge inside the transformer is an important cause of transformer failure. Ultrasonic detection is a common method for detecting and positioning partial discharge in transformers. According to the needs of rationally arranging ultrasonic sensors and optimizing the positioning algorithm, this paper carries out a simulation analysis of the propagation pattern of partial discharge ultrasonic signals inside the oil-immersed transformer. Based on the finite element simulation software, an oil-immersed transformer model was built, and different geometric structures and material parameters were designed for the transformer’s box, iron core, winding, and oil. The propagation mode of the partial discharge occurring in the oil passage between the high and low voltage windings, the high voltage winding and the outside of the winding in the transformer is analyzed, and the attenuation of the partial discharge ultrasonic signal in the transformer by the winding is studied. This article provides a certain reference for the layout and optimization of built-in ultrasonic sensors in oil-immersed power transformers.

articleTitle: Study on Space Charge Characteristics of XLPE at Different Temperature Gradients
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: As the main insulation material of DC cable, the insulation performance of crosslinked polyethylene(XLPE) directly affects the safety of cable operation, and the existence of space charge will lead to the distortion of field strength. Due to the temperature difference between the inner and outer layers of XLPE cables during operation, few studies have reported the effect of temperature gradient on the space charge distribution. Therefore, this paper establishes a two-dimensional model of the DC XLPE cable by means of numerical simulation, couples the temperature-electrostatic-charge multi-physical fields, simulating the space charge distribution based on the bipolar carrier transport (BCT) model, and considering the influence of temperature gradient on the results. In this paper, the charge distribution at the temperature gradient of 0 K and 15 K in the inner and outer layers of XLPE is studied. The results show that under different temperature gradients, the significant changes of charge mobility and charge rate injected from the electrodes result in a great difference in the charge distribution characteristics. The charge migration velocity on the side with higher temperature is faster than the charge injection depth on the side with lower temperature. The higher the temperature gradient, the greater the distortion rate of the field strength, so the more likely the insulation failure of the cable will occur.

articleTitle: Effect of Temperature Varying Rate on Moisture Migration in Oil-paper Insulation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Transformer is the key equipment of power system, oil-paper insulation is the main insulation form of transformer. The oil temperature is in a state of continuous change due to the change of load and ambient temperature, thus it is of great significance for transformer insulation to predict the moisture migration trend and study the moisture migration characteristics under different transient conditions. In this paper, moisture migration characteristics of two kinds of oil and pressboard combinations were studied under the condition of varying temperature and the moisture content of rapid heating and slow heating were obtained. Molecular dynamics simulation has been used to study the diffusion behavior of water molecules at the oil-paper interface. The results show that in rapid change of temperature, the unit cell volume and the microcrystalline body becomes larger, the moisture absorption capacity becomes weaker, and the number of hydrogen bonds between cellulose chain decreases in crystalline region of cellulose. The number of hydrogen bonds between water molecules and cellulose decrease and the molecular interchain spacing of cellulose decrease in amorphous region of cellulose. The moisture will not completely diffuse into the oil, and a high water area will be formed at the oil-paper interface.

articleTitle: Intelligent Diagnosis Method of Metering Cabinet Health State Based on Multi-source Information and Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The evaluation of the operation health status of the metering cabinet is helpful to ensure the stable operation of the distribution network system. Aiming at the problems of imperfect characteristic quantity system and insufficient basis for state classification in metering cabinet state evaluation method, a multi-source information layered state parameter model was established based on the state information of insulation, circuit breaker, environment, load, electric energy and cabinet door. Then, threshold mapping interval was established through operation experience and relevant standards, and then combined with analytic hierarchy process Finally, a comprehensive evaluation model of fuzzy state was established by combining fuzzy normal function with fuzzy normal function. The results show that the fuzzy state comprehensive evaluation model can reflect the characteristic information of equipment operation state, and the identification result of the model is consistent with the actual state, which can shield the state with lower membership degree.

articleTitle: Comparative Research on Discharge Gas Characteristics of Typical Defects in Pure Oil Gap
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The oil-less equipment is internally insulated by filling with insulating oil. When a discharge or overheating failure occurs, there is a phenomenon that a large amount of H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, hydrocarbon gas, CO and CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and other dissolved gases can be produced because of the small internal space. These can cause a explode in severe cases, resulting a huge economical loss. Therefore, a discharge test system for oil-less equipment is designed in the paper. Firstly, the gas diffusion characteristics in the oil after discharge is obtained. Secondly, the gas production test is studied under three typical electrodes, including the plate-plate electrode, ball-ball electrode and needle-plate electrode. Finally, the data of the test is obtained ats at different gap distances and charge time. The research results show that under plate-to-plate electrode discharge, the gas produced by direct pressurization to breakdown is small. The gas production increases with the increase of the gap distance during continuous discharge. The H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> content under 6mm pitch is 9.2 times, 5.9 times and 7.6 times larger than 3mm under discharge of 5s, 10s and 15s, respectively. The C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> content and H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> content of the ball electrode under 6mm pitch gradually increase with the increase of discharge time. After the gas concentration increases, the C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> generated by the discharge of the ball electrode and the needle plate electrode show a saturation trend. The three electrode discharges all show the law that the gas production increases with the increase of the discharge interval and discharge time. At the same discharge time, the needle plate electrode has the largest gas production volume, followed by the ball electrode, and the plate electrode has the smallest gas production volume. The change law of the discharge gas content in three typical electrode oils is obtained in the paper. There is a great significance for the failure analysis of oil-less equipment under gas production.

articleTitle: Spatial Electric Field Characteristics in Large-scale Oil-pressboard Insulation Structure under Impulse Voltage
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The reliable manufacture of the oil-pressboard insulation system of converter transformer largely depends on numerical calculation and electric field measurement under the simple equivalent model. It lacks electric field measurement verification under large-scale complex structure. The electric field characteristics in the large-scale valve-side outlet device model of the ± 800kV converter transformer under impulse voltage with different voltage amplitudes and different wavefront times was obtained in this paper. The actual measurement results show that the value of field intensity in three transformer oil-spacing will increase with the rise of the applied voltage amplitude. The peak value of field intensity in transformer oil-spacing would decrease with the rise of wavefront time. In the same oil-spacing, the closer the measuring point to the electrode of applied voltage, the bigger the peak value of field intensity, but the maximum deviation is about 3.61%, which may be due to the little accumulation of interface charge under lightning impulse voltage.

articleTitle: Study on Physicochemical and Electrical Properties of Different Oil-based Natural Ester Insulating Oils during Thermal Aging
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Natural ester, has the ability of protecting cellulose which could efficiently delay the aging of insulation pressboard, and is regard as the best alternative to mineral oil (MO). In this paper, an accelerated thermal aging test of oilpaper samples $120^{\circ}C$ was conducted, including mineral oil, FR3 oil, PFAE oil, cellulose insulation pressboard and thermally upgraded paper. The key parameters of insulating oils were analyzed, including liquid colour, power frequency breakdown voltage, thermal conductivity, specific heat capacity and infrared spectrum. Results show that PFAE has the highest power frequency breakdown voltage and slightest colour change during the aging process. The thermal conductivity and specific heat capacity of MO, PFAE and FR3 oil with different aging degrees all increased with the increase of temperature. Among the three insulating oils, PFAE has a relatively high specific heat capacity, which would be beneficial to reduce the transformer operating temperature. The infrared spectrum analysis shows that C-H vibration peaks appears in MO, but in PFAE and FR3 oil, the C=O stretching vibration peaks also exist which reflects the different structure of three insulating oils. This study has a certain reference value for the fault diagnosis and evaluation of natural ester transformer in the future.

articleTitle: State Evaluation System of Switchgear Based on Data Time-domain Processing and Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: As an important equipment in the power system, it is necessary to detect the running state of high voltage switchgear to ensure its normal operation. But most of current state detection methods for switchgear take a single feature as the basis of fault diagnosis. Failure to make full use of defect information will easily lead to misjudgment and missed detection. In this paper, infrared (IR) and ultraviolet (UV) sensors are used to detect the temperature and partial discharge (PD) information of the insulated equipment in switchgear, which are collected by data acquisition card and transmitted to PC, then, wavelet denoising and sliding window median filtering are carried out on the temperature data to eliminate clutter and spikes on waveform. In order to avoid distortion of pulse width, amplitude and position caused by data processing, a peak-valley extraction and location algorithm is proposed to realize the time domain analysis and feature extraction of PD. And adaptive neuro fuzzy inference strategy (ANFIS) based on Takagi-Sugeno model is used to realize data fusion and state evaluation. Through testing, the accuracy of data processing and feature fusion method in fault warning and diagnosis of test data reaches more than 94%, and the judgment of the running state of electrical equipment is more accurate.

articleTitle: Garbage Classification and Recognition System Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Traditional garbage classification has many errors and consumes resources seriously, which no longer meets the current needs of garbage classification. In response to these problems, this research proposes a garbage classification model based on migration learning and the application of this model to the actually created garbage separation device. First, pre-train the ResNet50 deep network learning model on the ImageNet dataset; Secondly, transfer the underlying features shared by the edges, colors, and textures learned by the convolution module of the ResNet50 deep network model to the residual network layer of the network model for garbage classification as the initialization parameters; Then use the extracted feature map as input to train the garbage classification model; Finally, modify the fully connected layer to a four-classification problem to accurately classify the garbage. By using the improved Trashnet training set to compare the three pre-training networks, namely alexnet, googlenet and resnet50, the results show that resnet50 has a relatively good recognition accuracy. After fine-tuning the training parameters and the training set, the final verification rate is 91.42%. which basically meet the accuracy requirements of garbage classification. At the same time, this garbage sorting network is implanted into the STM32F4 single-chip microcomputer through the Raspberry Pi to obtain a rubbish sorting device that can identify garbage. The photos recorded by the camera in real time are transmitted to the single-chip microcomputer for processing to obtain the classification result. At this time, the motor starts to work so that the garbage can fall into the corresponding bucket. While reducing the consumption of human and material resources, it greatly improves the accuracy of garbage classification and provides a new method for garbage classification.

articleTitle: Moisture Migration Process and its Characteristics of Transformer Oil-paper Insulation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Moisture is one of the most important factors affecting the performance of transformer oil-paper insulation. The moisture content and moisture distribution in transformer oil-paper insulation are the important basis for evaluating the insulation status of transformer. In order to explore the migration process and its characteristics of moisture in oil-paper insulation, this paper deeply analyzes the variation trend of moisture content in insulating oil and pressboard, and studies the relationship between moisture content in oil and pressboard when reaching equilibrium under the experimental conditions of 35°C, 50°C, 70°C and humidity of 20%, 40%, 60% and 80%.The results show that the migration of moisture in oil-paper is essentially two processes, one is the interaction of moisture between oil and external space, the other is the interaction of moisture between oil and pressboard, and oil is the intermediate medium; when the moisture migration reaches equilibrium, the moisture content diffused from the oil to the pressboard is equal to that from the pressboard to the oil. With the increasing of temperature, the moisture migrates from pressboard to oil.

articleTitle: GIS Optical Partial Discharge Pattarn Identification Based on Two-dimensional Gabor Transform and Image Features
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: This paper studied an innovative method of identifying GIS optical partial discharge (PD) pattern. This method mainly includes two important parts: two-dimensional Gabor transform and image features. At first, two-dimensional Gabor transform composing of Gabor filters can provide optimal localization in both time domain and frequency domain at the same time. Secondly, aiming at the optical PD pattern after two-dimensional Gabor transform, image features can be extracted in three aspects: color, texture and shape. This paper adopted multi-core support vector machine as the classifier in order to recognize three typical insulation defects. The test results proved that the above method can effectively extract the image features from the optical PD pattern after two-dimensional Gabor transform, thus improving the identification accuracy.

articleTitle: Study on Thermal Aging Characteristics of Epoxy Resin Impregnated Paper for Bushing
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Epoxy resin impregnated paper is the main insulating material of the RIP bushing which is widely used in electric power system, but the heat dissipation performance of epoxy resin impregnated paper is not good and the problem of thermal aging occurs, which seriously affects the safe operation of RIP bushing. In order to study the effect of thermal aging time on the FDS measurement results of epoxy resin impregnated paper, a long-time accelerated thermal aging test is carried out at 100°C for the same epoxy resin impregnated paper sample in different aging stages. The real part of capacitance of the sample at each aging stage decreases with the increase of frequency. With the increase of aging time, the frequency spectrum of imaginary part of capacitance and dielectric loss moves upward, and in the low frequency range of 0.002 Hz$\sim$1 Hz, it increases obviously with aging time and decreases with the increase of frequency, there is a peak value which increases with the increase of aging time at about 20Hz. With the increase of aging time, the power frequency dielectric loss of the sample increases gradually, after 1000 h of thermal aging, the power frequency dielectric loss of the sample increases to 2.04%, which is 4.9 times of that of the sample without aging. The conclusions provide design and operation basis for the safe operation of RIP bushing.

articleTitle: Effects of Mechanical Stress on Cohesive Energy and Energy Level Distribution of Bisphenol-A Epoxy Resin
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Epoxy resin is widely used in the field of electrical equipment insulation. In this paper, the effects of mechanical stress on cohesive energy and energy level distribution of epoxy resin were investigated. Tensile stress reduces the cohesive energy density of epoxy resin and accelerates the insulation deterioration. On the contrary, the compressive stress can restrain the insulation deterioration. The van der Waals interaction plays a more important role in changing the cohesive energy. The band gap of epoxy resin decreases and the polarizability increases under tensile stress. Under compression stress, the band gap increases and the polarizability decreases. The changes of molecular local state and polarization can affect the charge transport characteristics, which reveals the relationship between the insulation deterioration and the mechanical stress. The conclusion is helpful to understand the insulation failure mechanism of epoxy resin under mechanical stress.

articleTitle: Simulation Research of Optical Sensor Applied in GIS Partial Discharge Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Aiming at improving the accuracy and reliability of GIS partial discharge optical detection to ensure the safe and stable operation of the power system, this paper studied the performance of optical sensor based on the simulation. Firstly, this paper obtained the irradiance value and the number of light rays of lightpipe. Secondly, this paper compared and analyzed the performance of lightpipe from different aspects, including the surface at end, the radius of bottom, the depth of cone, the length and diameter of lightpipe. Finally, the most suitable lightpipe design of optical sensor was found to provide referrence for design of optical sensor.

articleTitle: Prediction of transformer top oil temperature based on improved weighted support vector regression based on particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: A support vector regression (SVR) based on particle swarm optimization (PSO) is proposed to estimate the top oil temperature of transformer. This model establishes SVR model based on sample data such as ambient temperature, transformer load, and top oil temperature of transformer. The model analyzes the relationship between the top oil temperature of transformer and other factors, establishes the support vector hyperplane according to different influencing factors, and limits the prediction of the top oil temperature of transformer to a reasonable interval. According to the choice of penalty factor and relaxation factor of support vector machine, the error between this area and the actual oil temperature of the top layer of transformer is minimized, and the top-oil temperature prediction model has the highest prediction accuracy. PSO is used to optimize the penalty factor and relaxation factor in SVR model. The kernel function is improved by principal component analysis to optimize the support vector regression model. Compared with particle swarm optimization(pso) support vector machine(SVM), which considers the weight of data feature quantity, the prediction accuracy is higher.This model uses the advantages of support vector regression method, such as not requiring a large number of samples, not involving probability measure, and being able to deal with multi-dimensional influencing factors, etc.It can provide accurate top-oil temperature prediction results in case of insufficient short-term prediction data of transformer oil temperature or more dimensions of oil temperature related data collected.

articleTitle: Design of Monitoring Sensors for Rope Force in Assembling Tower with Inside Suspension Pole
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of safety accidents that often occur during the assembly process of the inner suspension pole power transmission tower due to the overload of the tower ropes, a sensor for monitoring the force of the inner suspension pole group tower ropes is designed. According to the construction characteristics of the inner suspension pole group tower and the force characteristics of the rope, the foil strain gauge and the single-chip STC12LE5616AD are selected to complete the collection and processing of the force data of the tower rope, and the low-power ZigBee technology is used to complete the wireless data transmission. The software system adopts the low power consumption working mode of automatic sleep and timing wake-up to complete the polling transmission of multi-point acquisition data. Determine the shape and structure of the sensor according to the tower rope connection fittings, and use ANSYS simulation calculation to determine that the metal housing of the sensor is made of 42CrMO material.

articleTitle: Research on Leakage Magnetic Field and Electrodynamic Force of Large Transformer Windings Based on Finite Element Simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Studying the distribution of leakage magnetic field and short circuit electrodynamic force of transformer windings during short circuit can better ensure the smooth operation of transformers. It can also reduce the probability of accidents, and reduce the impact on power system due to short circuit fault. Based on the dimensional parameters of a large power transformer with a capacity of 240000kVA, a two-dimensional axisymmetric transformer model in the finite element simulation software is established. The distribution of leakage magnetic density of transformer winding is obtained, and the distribution of leakage magnetic field and electrodynamic density of high and low voltage windings are plotted. The leakage magnetic field distribution laws of high and low voltage windings are summarized to lay the foundation for the study of cumulative effect of transformer winding deformation.

articleTitle: Design of Wireless Sensor Network Architecture for Power Transmission and Transformation Business
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: In view of the problems that the existing status-aware business of transmission and transformation equipment uses a large number of private protocols which are incompatible with each other and mature wireless communication protocols which cannot meet the actual business needs in collection, transmission, networking, etc., this paper carries out the analysis of power business scenarios and the characteristics of the perceived data, establishes the unified perception layer of the Internet of Things for transmission and substation equipment, and improves the wireless sensor network architecture, realizes the unification of multi-types wireless sensor under complex business scenarios access and connectivity.

articleTitle: Deformation Monitoring System of Transmission Tower
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Due to the influence of weather and various human factors, the transmission tower will be deformed, which will affect the operation of the transmission tower. In order to monitor the deformation of transmission tower, a deformation monitoring system is designed in this paper. The system consists of 15 wireless acceleration sensors, a wind speed and direction sensor, a monitoring terminal and a monitoring center. Acceleration sensor and monitoring terminal transmit data through wireless transmission; The output analog signal of wind speed and direction sensor is directly transmitted to the monitoring terminal; The monitoring terminal realizes data transmission through 4G network and monitoring center, which can monitor the deformation of transmission tower in real time.

articleTitle: A Novel Partial Discharge Localization Method in Transformer based on Signal Propagation in Winding
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Partial discharge is one of the important causes of transformer faults. The detection and localization of partial discharges in transformers are of great significance to ensure the safe operation of power systems. The finite element model of the transformer winding was built, lumped parameters of the transformer winding were solved by the finite element method. The equivalent circuit with two disks as the unit of transformer winding was established, and the propagation principle of the pulse signals excited by main insulation partial discharge and longitudinal insulation partial discharge were studied. Research showed that the signals of the main insulation partial discharge received at both ends of the winding were of the same polarity, and the pulse amplitude attenuated with the increase of the propagation distance. The localization of the main insulation partial discharge could be realized by calculating the proportion of energy in the middle-frequency region; The longitudinal insulation partial discharge signals received at both ends of the winding were of different polarity, and the pulse amplitude hardly attenuated with the increase of the propagation distance. the Localization of the longitudinal insulation partial discharge could be realized by calculating the arrival time of the first peak of the pulse. This study provided a new method of electrical localization of the partial discharge in transformer

articleTitle: Research on Supporting Control Technology of Wind driven generator Auxiliary Power Grid Based on Energy Storage DC Access
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Under MPPT mode, It is very difficult for permanent magnet direct drive wind driven generator to respond correctly to changes in the frequency of the grid. Large-scale wind driven generators connected to the power grid will increase the frequency regulation pressure of the power system. The traditional frequency control system reserves a part of active power for frequency regulation by reducing the generating efficiency of wind driven generator, but there are also some problems such as small frequency range and frequent adjustment of pitch Angle. Therefore, this paper proposes a control method based on hybrid energy storage DC access to single wind driven generator auxiliary power grid frequency support, and designed a set of energy storage equipment and wind driven generator with complementary advantages of battery and super capacitor to respond to the power grid FM regulation wind power generation system.

articleTitle: Power system security assessment based on real-time electromagnetic-electromechanical transient hybrid simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Since the modern power system presents a “double high” trend, the operation mechanism becomes more and more complicate, that puts forward higher requirements for power system simulation. Electro-mechanical transient(TS) simulation cannot fully reflect the fast response dynamic characteristics of power electronic equipment. Due to the speed, scale and amount limitation of calculation, current electro-magnetic transient (EMT) simulation cannot perform large-scale power grid simulation. Based on TS simulation software PSS/E and EMT simulation software RTDS, a real-time EMT-TS hybrid simulation platform was developed in the previous work, we extend it to a large scale AC/DC power system in this paper. As an important issue for hybrid simulation, an interface bus location method is proposed. Also, a power system security assessment method based on the hybrid simulation is presented. These above are tested in a real power system of China.

articleTitle: A Motor-driven Actuator Servo Controller Current Loop Optimization Scheme
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The motor-driven high-voltage circuit breaker actuator requires high dynamic response of the motor, but when the motor is controlled by vector control technology, the current controller does not achieve complete decoupling of the motor, and the influence of the coupling term will be enhanced with the increase of the speed, which greatly affects the dynamic response accuracy of the motor. Therefore, in this paper, firstly, the existing decoupling methods are analyzed and studied to improve the dynamic response characteristics of the permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) in operation. Secondly, to further improve the dynamic tracking performance of the current loop, a predictive controller is introduced in the feedback link in combination with the predictive control algorithm to replace the measured value with the predicted value as the feedback input of the controller, so that the regulator output and the feedback input can be synchronized in timing, which is expected to eliminate the influence of the one-shot lag delay of the digital controller. Then, under this control method, the parameter selection method is further investigated when the controller is a PI controller. Simulation and experimental results show that the proposed scheme can effectively improve the dynamic response performance of the current loop, enable the circuit breaker to quickly track the command signal, the motion characteristics are stable, and the breaking speed meets the requirements.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of High-Voltage Circuit Breaker Based on Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: High-voltage circuit breaker is one of the key components in the power grid, and mechanical faults often occur during long-time operation. A method based on digital twin for mechanical fault diagnosis of high-voltage circuit breaker is proposed in this paper. First, a finite element twin model is established to simulate the opening and closing operation of high-voltage circuit breaker to simulate its typical coil currents, then measured coil currents are obtained from the actual circuit breaker. Both the virtual data and measured data are utilized to train the KNN model to perform the fault diagnosis of five operation states. Experimental results show that the proposed digital twin method can simulate the operation of high-voltage circuit breaker, provide more failure types of data and can efficaciously diagnose mechanical faults with a high classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Key Technology of Nondestructive Testing of Solid Insulating Materials in Power Equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Power system is the center of modern society, but there are always various faults in the process of power system operation. Detection technology is very important for the good operation of power system. Nondestructive testing technology, as a special part of detection technology, has broad development prospects. This paper mainly focuses on the four common nondestructive testing methods of X-ray, ultrasound, CT and partial discharge in nondestructive testing technology, analyzes and prospects the current research status from different angles such as the characteristics, innovation and detection system of testing methods, summarizes the current research progress, and looks forward to the frontier problems in the future.

articleTitle: Design and Ccomparison of Three Schemes of High Voltage Nanosecond Trigger
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: In order to provide a Marx generator with pulses with a leading edge less than 30ns and a half-width greater than 200ns, the circuits of Marx generator type flip-flop, pulse transformer type flip-flop and capacitor fast discharge type flipflop are studied, and the effects of circuit parameters on output pulses are analyzed. On this basis, three kinds of triggers are designed and simulation models are established, and the optimal scheme is selected by comparing the simulation results.

articleTitle: Simulation of Fire Spread in Cable Tunnel with Different Fire Barriers
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: With the acceleration of urban construction and power grid transformation, underground cables play an increasingly important role in urban power supply. However, in recent years, frequent cable fire accidents have seriously affected the safe operation of power grid. The importance of cable fire prevention, especially cable tunnel fire prevention, is increasing day by day. Practice has proved that the use of cable fire barrier can effectively inhibit the spread of cable fire and reduce the risk of cable combustion. However, the problem of which is the best way to lay the fire barrier has not been solved. Based on the finite element simulation software, this paper establishes a fire simulation model of underground high-voltage cable trench in substation. By simulating the fire spread trend, the change of temperature field inside the tunnel and the difference of various gas distribution under the two common laying methods of fireproof partition, it draws the following conclusions: the laying method of fireproof partition above the cable is better than the laying method of fireproof partition below the cable, Compared with the cable laying method of the lower fireproof partition, the laying method of the upper fireproof partition can more effectively slow down the fire spreading speed, produce less toxic gas, and form a lower fire temperature field.

articleTitle: Research on ultrasonic array positioning of Partial Discharge in GIS based on Incoherent Signal Subspace Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Partial discharge is the main reason of insulation aging of GIS equipment. It is very important to find and locate the location of partial discharge for safe operation of GIS equipment. In this paper, we use an array of $2 \times 3$ approximate planes, and the detected data is denoised by sparse decomposition theory. According to the waveform comparison before and after denoising, the output signal-to-noise ratio of each array element is significantly improved compared with the input signal-to-noise ratio. Then the Incoherent Signal Subspace Method (ISM) algorithm is used for simulation, the analysis results show that the original data is de-noising, and then the Incoherent Signal Subspace Method (ISM) is used for simulation, which shows that the direction finding spectrum peak is concentrated and sharp after de-noising, and the direction finding effect has been improved to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Identification of Defects in Ultrasonic Inspection of Overhead Distribution Lines Based on Bayesian Classification Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: In China, overhead distribution lines are widely used in the power grids of rural and suburban areas. They take on the role of power delivery. The safe and stable operation of overhead distribution lines is of great significance to the reliability of power supply. In recent years, power companies in China have begun to use ultrasonic testing device to inspect defects on overhead distribution lines and have achieved good results. However, there are still some problems. The camera of the existing ultrasonic testing device has a low resolution and it can only judge whether there is a defect in a certain area. In addition, there are often many equipment in the picture. So it is difficult to identify the specific defective equipment. Therefore, it is often necessary to combine the cooperation of a high-definition camera, which increases the work cost and reduces the inspection efficiency. In order to solve these problems, this paper conducts a detailed statistical analysis of ultrasonic testing data of Shaanxi Electric Power Company from 2017 to 2020. Then a defect classification model for overhead distribution lines based on Bayesian classification algorithm is established. It is only necessary to obtain the testing data of existing testing device to calculate the specific equipment which the defect occurred. The results of sample test and field test show that the Bayesian classification model established in this paper can effectively identify the specific defective equipment. In the actual inspection process, the combination of ultrasonic testing device and Bayesian classification model can save cost and improve work efficiency.

articleTitle: Review on Functional Architecture and Key Technologies of Intelligent Substation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Intelligent substation is the key link of building Strong-Smart Grid and power Internet of Things. The key architectural composition of intelligent substation, the structure of the perception layer and the upper application platform are introduced in this paper. The typical function characteristics and application of intelligent substation are analyzed. Finally, in terms of the intellisense terminals, the intelligent analysis algorithm, and the network real-time communication ability, the restriction of the existing key problems and its research direction suggestion are discussed. There is a certain reference value of this paper to improve and develop the function of the intelligent substation.

articleTitle: Research on Breaking Arc Characteristics of Circuit Breakers under Harmonic Current
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: In recent years, a large number of new energy sources such as wind power and photovoltaics have been continuously connected to the grid, and the power system has gradually shown a trend of power electronics. The problem of excessive harmonics has gradually become prominent, which has greatly affected the safe and stable operation of the power grid. There is a risk of failure to break the circuit breaker when the harmonic is exceeded. Studying the influence of harmonics on the breaking of switchgear and formulating effective countermeasures are important technical measures to ensure the safe and reliable operation of the power grid. In this paper, by establishing an arc magnetohydrodynamic model under harmonic currents, the circuit breaker breaking characteristics under harmonic currents are developed. Studies have shown that the existence of harmonics in the system will cause the current change rate di/dt to increase significantly at the time of the current zero-crossing point in the circuit breaker opening process, and with the increase of the harmonic amplitude, the di/dt becomes larger; Existence will cause the arc voltage amplitude and rate of rise before zero crossing during the circuit breaker opening process to decrease; the presence of harmonics will cause the temperature of the arc extinguishing chamber to rise during the circuit breaker opening process; the above harmonics will affect the opening process It is not conducive to the successful opening of the circuit breaker.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategy of Servo Motor Used to Drive High Voltage Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Motor-drive high voltage circuit breaker (HVCB) is becoming a research hotspot because of the high mechanical reliability, the controllability of the whole process of movement, and the potential to realize intelligence. However, the application in high voltage level is constrained due to the requirement of large energy output within a short period. To increase motor torque, improve torque utilization and reduce consumption of hardware resource, the simplified algorithm of maximum torque per ampere (MTPA) is proposed in this paper. For this reason, the mathematical model of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) is introduced, and the exact algorithm of MTPA and the simplified one are derived respectively. The adams/simulink co-simulation model of HVCB driven by servo motor is established and the experiment platform is built in order to verify the effectiveness of the simplified MTPA(S-MTPA),. The conclusion that the control accuracy of S-MTPA can meet the requirements of HVCB is proved by the results of simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Research on Thermal Stress Distribution of GIS Basin Insulator
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Basin insulator is an important part of gas insulated metal enclosed switchgear (GIS). Its mechanical performance is not good, which is easy to cause insulation failure, which threatens the safe and stable operation of GIS, and thermal stress is one of the reasons for the deterioration of mechanical performance of basin insulator. In order to study the distribution law of thermal stress and strain of basin insulator, this paper establishes 252 kV GIS basin insulator simulation model by combining simulation and test, and establishes a thermal stress ultrasonic detection system. The distribution law of thermal stress and strain of 252 kV GIS basin insulator is obtained by finite element simulation analysis and stress ultrasonic longitudinal wave reflection detection. The results show that the temperature of the insulator is gradiently distributed along the conductor flange direction when the center conductor is under the temperature load. The thermal stress and the thermal strain decrease gradually along the conductor flange direction, and increase with the increase of the temperature load. The normal ultrasonic propagation time is characterized by normal thermal strain, which is proportional to the temperature load.

articleTitle: Excellent Energy Storage of PVTC-Based Composites at Low Electric Field by Filling with Core-Shell CCTO@SiO2 Nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Polymer film has a wide range of applications in power equipment because of its excellent energy storage characteristics. Here, an innovative approach of ferroelectric polymer composites with core-shell structured inorganic fillers is proposed. In this paper, the CaCu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>Ti<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</inf>(CCTO) nanoparticles are coated by SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> as inorganic fillers and dispersed in P(VDF-TrFE-CFE) (PVTC). The CCTO-PVTC and $\mathrm{CCTO} \text{@} \mathrm{SiO}_{2}-\mathrm{PVTC}$ nanocomposites are fabricated by solution casting technique. In particular, compared with the CCTO-PVTC composites, the energy storage properties of the $\mathrm{CCTO} \text{@} \mathrm{SiO}_{2}-\mathrm{PVTC}$ films are improved at given content. In addition, the thin SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> layer can not only improve the interfacial compatibility between CCTO and polymer matrix, but also delay the premature interfacial breakdown caused by electric field concentration. The composite filled with 1 wt % $\mathrm{CCTO} \text{@} \mathrm{SiO}_{2}$ nanoparticles show an energy density of 6.9 J / $\mathrm{cm}^{3}$ and an excellent efficiency of 50 % under the electric field of 310 kV/mm.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis on Heating of Metal Structure in Leakage Magnetic Field of Arm Inductor in Converter Station
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The Modular Multilevel Converters (MMC) based Voltage Source Converter High Voltage DC (VSC-HVDC) power transmission technology has been widely used worldwide. The arm inductor in the MMC plays a role of controlling power transmission, filtering, and suppressing AC side current fluctuations. The dry-type air-core reactor used by MMC generates an alternating magnetic field under the excitation of the AC at 50 Hz, which may induce a current in the metal structure forming a loop in the arm inductor room. When contact resistance appears in the metal loop, significant heating may occur. This paper built simulation models based on the actual size of the arm inductor of a converter station and simulated the partial heating phenomenon caused by the contact resistance and the limited heat dissipation ability, reproduced the observed temperature rise phenomenon under the actual operation condition of the converter station. This work confirmed the feasibility of measures to reduce the temperature rise and has certain guiding significance for future HVDC projects.

articleTitle: The Effects of Temperature on Current Distribution Characteristic of Multi-column Surge Arrester
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The switching overvoltages in HVDC power system usually have long duration time and discharge more energy than normal stations. The multi-column surge arresters are usually used to improve energy absorption ability, which effected by the current distribution among columns. Although the columns have carefully matched by the manufacturers when they are initially put in service, the current distribution can change if temperature difference goes up, which caused by the uneven ageing or nonuniform lighting. This paper studies the effects of temperature on current distribution characteristic of multi-column arresters, which come from three manufacturers. Two different types of experiments were carried out, including uniform and nonuniform temperature rise. The research results show that when the temperature of the metal oxide varistor is the overall rise, the characteristic of current distribution with temperature make a difference, but the max-nonuniformity coefficient does not exceed the standard limit. The nonuniformity coefficient of current distribution is increased with the rise of temperature different between columns.

articleTitle: The Influence of Ambient Temperature on Physical Field in Oil-immersed Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
