By constructing a 3D model construction of the power chip, the valuable impact of digital twin technology application is discussed in addition.

articleTitle: Edge Terminal Data Sharing Architecture Under Smart Grid Panoramic Information Perception
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: In order to achieve higher requirements for collaborative optimization capabilities of edge terminals at the field level, and to meet the demand of data sharing between perception layer terminals and local decision-making under the authorization of the smart grid, a smart grid panoramic information perception of edge terminal data sharing architecture is designed. Based on the analysis of terminal data sharing and coordination demand, and research on the weak communication between the existing on-site terminals of the distribution network, the article expands the local communication mode, realizes the data sharing architecture design of edge terminal, which can sense, share and make local decisions in the perception layer, and breaks through the limitations of single terminal in terms of function, performance and access resources. Finally, through the examples of edge terminal sharing and its application scenario analysis, the specific data sharing route and the rationality of the architecture design are explained.

articleTitle: Influence of Penning Ionization and Attachment Reaction Rates on Dielectric Barrier Discharge
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: In order to Figure out the role of Penning ionization and attachment reaction in changing atmospheric DBD characteristics, a one-dimension fluid model is built based on Ar/NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> dielectric barrier discharge (DBD). The Penning ionization and attachment reaction rates are multiplied by different coefficient $\eta$ and $\xi$, respectively, to change corresponding reaction intensity. Plasma parameters are investigated, including breakdown threshold, electron temperature, cathode falling thickness, ionization efficiency of Ar/NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> DBD, different particles density and evolution. Compared with attachment reaction, the absence of Penning ionization will have more remarkable influence on DBD characteristics.

articleTitle: Research on Bushing Fault Diagnosis Method Based on DCNN
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: In this paper, the partial discharge (PD) characteristic test is carried out for the four types of typical defective bushings, and the PD characteristics of different typical defective bushings are obtained. The deep convolutional neural network (DCNN) Inception-resnet-light is designed, and the PRPD grayscale image is constructed from the PD test data of different defective bushings as the model input. The method of image recognition is adopted to extract the non-linear characteristics of bushing defects and classify them, then realize the bushing fault diagnosis method based on DCNN. And the model verification is carried out by using examples of defective bushing. The results show that the equivalent frequency of the bushing PD is mainly distributed between 5. 6MHz and 9. 0MHz, and the equivalent time is between 113ns and 1200ns. The PD characteristics of different defective bushings have certain differences, but have a high degree of similarity. The bushing fault diagnosis model based on DCNN which established in this paper can effectively classify bushing defects, and the accuracy of identification on the instance defect bushing is 97.26%, which proves that the proposed method has good generalization performance and feasibility.

articleTitle: Research on Mechanical Model of Pipe Laying and Position Computing of 3D Date Set of High-Voltage Power Cable
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: With the technology maturity of horizontal directional drilling, pipe laying has become widely used for underground power transmission engineering construction. But, a unified mechanical model of pipe laying has not been established so far, deformation remains a frequent complication of sheath and insulation of high-voltage power cable due to traction accuracy that can not be guaranteed. Based on analysis of horizontal directional drilling characteristics, the mechanical model of pipe laying and the calculation formula of traction of cable were proposed and the determination method of model separation and classification was discussed, in which position computing of 3D date set by space vector theory was adopted. The feasibility and necessity of the model were verified by 110kV engineering example. The result indicated that not only the model can precisely predict traction of high-voltage power cable with less dispersion, its application can well avoid deformation of high-voltage power cable during cable lying.

articleTitle: Research on Modular and Intelligent Design of High Voltage Circuit Breaker Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: For the power system, in addition to the need for a circuit breaker to start protection to cut off the circuit when the equipment or line fails, other power outages are hoped to be avoided. At this stage, the mechanism replacement of the circuit breaker and the isolating switch still needs to be performed in the case of power failure, and the degree of modularity of the product is not high. Therefore, the modular design of the high-voltage switch not only has the value of technical research, but also has very important practical application value. In this article, we have studied a modular and intelligent scheme of circuit breaker mechanism. The integrated transformation plan of the secondary system of the circuit breaker mechanism is proposed according to the function. A scheme to ensure the output consistency of the circuit breaker mechanism is proposed to ensure the interchangeability between different mechanisms. And the monitoring IED for the breaker mechanism is designed. It has a good promotion for the digital development of circuit breaker equipment.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation of Flexible Interconnected Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: With large-scale distributed generation (DG) being integrated into distribution networks, the idea of using power electronic devices to improve distribution network operation have attracted increasing attentions. The transition of distribution networks into flexible interconnected ones, which contain considerable penetrations of AC/DC converters and soft open points (SOPs) is foreseen. In this paper, an optimization framework to improve the operation of the new form of distribution networks is proposed, where a novel searching technique is developed to determine the optimal set-points of the power electronic devices with increased efficiency. A generic power flow algorithm considering different modes of the controllable devices is presented, where the power flow problem is formulated into a set of nonlinear equations, and a globally convergent Newton-trust region method is adopted to solve it. Results of the case study demonstrate the feasibility and efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Key Parameters of Long-term Induced Withstand Voltage and Partial Discharge Test for ±800 kV Converter Transformer in Lingzhou and Interference Elimination of Partial Discharge
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: During the tests of long-term induced withstand voltage on site and handover partial discharge for ± 800 kV UHV converter transformers in Lingzhou, in accordance with the requirements of the regulations and standards for the above tests, the differences between the two types of converter transformers with angle valve and star valve in the two tests were studied respectively. And the parameters of the configured test equipment were calculated and verified. Taking the converter transformer with star valve as an example, the paper elaborates in detail from the test principles, instruments used, parameter calculations and on-site tests, also summarizes the precautions of each link, verifies the applicability and generalization of the research, and provides methods for the interference elimination of the relevant partial discharge test in the electrification converter station with charged electrification.

Author Keywords: test of long-term induced withstand voltage on site

articleTitle: Study on the Power Frequency Overvoltage and Reactive Power Allocation in Interconnected Offshore HVAC Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: With the development of large-scale offshore wind power systems in recent years, there are some potential issues to be solved in a large number of offshore wind farms for AC system connected to grids, especially for the studies of the impacts of offshore wind farms to the power system in terms of reactive power and voltage disturbance. In practical electrical engineering, restriction on the voltage should also be considered in determining the scheme of reactive power compensation. This paper theoretically analyzed the reactive power distribution of offshore wind farms. Also, it obtained and analyzed the frequency overvoltage of an interconnected offshore high-voltage AC transmission project under four operating conditions by using ATP/EMTP software. It checked whether shunt reactors need to be installed and whether the capacity of reactors can meet the requirements for frequency overvoltage protection. Finally, a reactive power compensation device selection and allocation scheme is proposed, and the corresponding feasibility is verified.

articleTitle: Research on Wireless Low Power Detection Technology of Transformer Winding Deformation Based on Frequency Response Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Frequency response method is an effective method to detect transformer winding deformation. At present, most tests are conducted with active power supply and long-distance signal connection. Problems such as difficulty in obtaining power at the test site and power quality that cannot meet the requirements of high-precision testing occur from time to time. The problem of superimposing spurious parameters on long-distance signal connections to reduce data accuracy and consistency needs to be resolved. Based on the detection principle of the frequency response method, this paper develops a battery-powered wireless low-power on-board detection system, which solves the problems of on-site power supply and signal long-distance transmission distortion. The test results of the winding of the real transformer show that under the same conditions, the correlation coefficient of the second detection amplitude-frequency characteristic curve of the wireless low-power onboard detection system is 0.982, and the correlation coefficient of the standard detection system amplitude-frequency characteristic curve is 0.951. The system has high detection consistency and accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Task Scheduling Algorithm for Edge Computing in Low-voltage transformer the area network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Aiming at the task scheduling strategy and performance optimization problems in the edge computing of the power Internet of Things, to meet the needs of refined and intelligent power distribution in the Low-voltage transformer the area, this paper studies how to effectively schedule applications to achieve task operation, processing time, and task delay And the trade-off between system performance. Taking into account the local advantages of the edge of the Internet of Things agents in the Low-voltage transformer the area(LV-TAN), as well as the characteristics of the edge intelligent computing tasks in the power distribution domain of the Low-voltage transformer the area, and the physical static characteristics of the Low-voltage transformer the area, it is established to minimize task running time as the goal, while considering the stability of the task queue, Balance, priority, and propose a scheduling strategy for edge computing based on container scheduling algorithm. This strategy decomposes the optimization problem into a series of sub-problems, and distributes tasks according to the current status of the queue backlog and unloading target nodes to meet the optimization goals of the distribution Low-voltage transformer the area and ensure the stability of the system. The simulation results show that the algorithm effectively reduces the task scheduling time, increases the CPU utilization rate, and reduces the jitter of task processing.

articleTitle: Application of Fuzzy Evaluation Method Based on D-S Evidence Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Main transformer of thermal power plant is the key electrical equipment. And it is important to evaluate the state of transformer. However, with a large number of features, it is difficult to properly fuse evaluation information and evaluate the state of transformer accurately. This paper proposed a fuzzy evaluation method based on D-S evidence theory. First, transformer testing data was collected and classified into four components: body, casing, oil and chromatography. Then, establish an evaluation model according to existing standards and expert database, which included indicator evaluation method based on fuzzy membership degree and weight calculation method based on analytic hierarchy process. After that, the component states were obtained by integrating the indicators and weights of each state quantity with evidence theory. Finally, the evaluation results of each component are fused to get the overall evaluation results of the equipment. Besides, a confirmed multi-evidences case was made to test the applicability of two improvement methods of D-S evidence theory: Yager and improved Yager. The results shows that improved Yager method has better performance in conflict evidence fusion and more suitable for equipment condition evaluation. This method can effectively judge the case of transformer oil damp defect. It is proved that this method can solve the problem that evaluation indicators are difficult to integrate. And a damp oil case was evaluated correctly, which proves the feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Extracting Features of Partial Discharge Pulse Current Signal
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Partial discharge (PD) not only causes the aging of the internal insulation of the power transformer but also characterizes the deterioration of the insulation system. During the operation of the power transformer, different types of partial discharges (PDs) may occur inside. The opportune PD pattern recognition is of great significance to the maintenance and operation stability of the transformer. The pulse current method is a widely used PD detection method, and the feature extraction of pulse current signal is a key step in PD pattern recognition. The present feature extraction method of pulse current signal usually uses a complex algorithm and takes a long computing time, which is not suitable for field application. This paper proposed a fast and effective method for extracting features of PD pulse current signals. The features extracted by this method can correctly classify the three typical insulation defects in transformers.

articleTitle: High-dimensional Feature Optimization Modeling Considering the Characteristics of Non-intrusive Load Identification Model Based on Edge Computing Architecture
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Considering the characteristics of the non-intrusive load identification model, this paper studies a high-dimensional feature optimization modeling based on edge computing architecture. This method uses the NILM terminal to collect load data, window to detect events, generate physical feature data of load, and transmit it to the regional edge server. The edge server constructs high-dimensional features and inputs them into the load identification model, and sends the recognition result to the terminal. In this paper, principal component analysis is used to find the relationship between high-dimensional feature space and load identification model, and to generate feature subsets suitable for specific models. The results show that this method greatly improves the training efficiency and recognition accuracy of the model, and provides a new research way for non-intrusive load identification.

articleTitle: Molecular Dynamics Simulation Analysis of Insulating Oil-paper Pyrolysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: China’s ultra high voltage direct current (UHV DC) transmission lines are increasing day by day, and the converter transformer is one of the core equipment of UHV DC transmission, so its safety and stability affect the stability of the entire system. In converter transformer faults, insulation faults account for the largest proportion. The insulation of converter transformers is affected by high temperature during operation and is prone to deterioration. Most of the current research studies on converter transformer insulation from the macro level, Using molecular dynamics from the micro level to study the products and production pathways of insulating oil-paper degradation is of great significance for understanding the degradation of converter transformer insulation. In this paper, insulating oil-paper molecular models are first built, and molecular dynamics simulation is used to reveal the generation path of insulating oil products. Then, the simulation of insulating oil paper mixing system is carried out to reveal the mechanism of insulating oil-paper degradation at high temperature.

articleTitle: Power Entity Information Recognition Method Based on Bi-LSTM+CRF
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: During the long-term operation, power companies have accumulated a large amount of text-based data in the form of natural language. In these text-based data, entities are key semantic units, including faulty equipment, locations, phenomena, etc. The extraction of these entities is the basic work for the construction of electrical knowledge graph and faults diagnosis. However, due to the unstructured form of text-based data, it is difficult to extract entities automatically. This paper introduced a deep learning model for power entity information entity extraction, using each Chinese character as the basic unit, and employing the Word2vec model to convert each character into a vector containing contextual semantic information. Then the vector is introduced into the Bi-LSTM (Bidirectional-Long Short Term Memory) network model. In addition, the transition probability between them are comprehensively considered in the Conditional Random Field (CRF) layer. So the best tag sequence of the sentence are obtained. In the case analysis, the entities of 550 onsite text-based data was extracted. The F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> value of the extraction results was higher than that based on the power dictionary and matching scheme.

articleTitle: A Single-Stage AC/DC Converter With Wide Output Voltage Range
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Traditional single-phase AC/DC converter requires two conversion stages to control the output voltage and achieve power factor correction respectively. A large electrolytic capacitor is commonly adoptedly to stabilize DC bus voltage. This paper suggests a single-stage AC/DC converter based on asymmetrical dual active bridge converter. It integrates the PFC circuit and the DC/DC stage into one stage and reduce the value of DC-bus capacitor. To realize wide output voltage range, this paper investigates the operating modes and the condition of smoothly switching in different modes. The operating principle and the design of the controller are detailed analyzed. Finally, simulation results are carried out to verify the feasibility of the converter.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation on the Distribution of Ion Flow near Wind Turbine Under Thundercloud
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Lightning damage is a huge threat to wind turbine, which influences the safe operation of wind turbine. There are some applications of lightning protection system (LPS) on wind turbine, especially on wind turbine blades. However, the rotation of wind turbine will influence the distribution of charged ions near blade tip, increasing the difficulty of full lightning protection on wind turbine. In this paper, 2-D drift and convection model coupled with Poisson equation of charged particles near wind turbine blade under thundercloud was established, based on which the distribution of glow corona ions near blade tip was calculated. The influence of blade rotation and polarity effect were further studied. As a result of the rotation, the high density of charged ions accumulates like arc shape at the side in the negative rotating direction. And the positive ions have an effect on the electric potential making it invert to positive mainly at the same direction. Under positive thundercloud, positively charged particles distort the field and have a shielding effect on the electric field, so that the upward leaders under negative thundercloud are easier to initiate.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Inhibition of Power System Oscillation Based on TLS-ESPRIT Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: It is easy to induce interregional oscillation in power system interconnected network under some weak link operation modes. In this paper, the control sensitivity of the multi DC system is judged by using TLS-ESPRIT method. The DC additional damping controller is designed. A new prototype testing model based on the matlab-simulink environment is proposed. The control logic compilation is completed and the actual control prototype is made. The Real Time Digital Simulation system full electromagnetic transient simulation test platform is built, and the parameters of the DC additional damping controller are optimized by simulation. The validity of the DC additional controller is verified by the North-Central china power grid model.

articleTitle: ReaxFF MD Investigation on the Damage Mechanism of Epoxy Polymer Exposed to DC Corona Discharge in SF6 Gas
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Corona discharge fault is inevitable in high voltage direct current gas insulated switchgear and gas insulated transmission-line (HVDC GIS/GIL), which will cause irreversible damage to the insulation strength of surface for the casting epoxy insulator. This research conducts a joint investigation of experiment and simulation on the damage mechanism of epoxy polymer exposed to DC corona discharge in SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas. A corona erosion test platform for epoxy polymer was established. Combined with microscopic morphology test, element analysis and macroscopic roughness test, the surface damage characteristics of epoxy resin under corona erosion in SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> were mastered in the experimental study. Furthermore, the molecular dynamics model of the polymer under SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> decomposition products bombardment was constructed based on the developed reactive force-field (ReaxFF) for SFO system. Through comparing the effects of four featured particles, F, SF, OH and SOF, bombardment, it was found that SF particles is the most destructive for epoxy polymer. Specifically, the mass loss and damage penetration depth of epoxy resin system were the highest. This simulation study based on molecular dynamics (MD) not only elucidates the mechanism of corona damage to epoxy resin and explains the physical phenomenon, but also provides a universal and novel method to study the damage and erosion effect of corona on dielectrics.

articleTitle: The phenomenon during the growth of electrical trees in insulating dielectrics
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The formation and growth of electrical trees is a very complex process, including many physical and chemical changes. Until now, the exact process of electrical trees initiation and growth has not been fully understood. This article mainly studies various phenomena during the growth of electrical trees, focusing on the growth characteristics of electrical trees under different voltages and various physical and chemical changes. Through the study of these phenomena, we have a deeper understanding of the formation and development of electrical tree defects in insulating dielectrics.Through the microscope real-time observation system, the initiation and growth characteristics of electrical tree defects in the insulating medium are studied.Using a variety of measurement methods to study the aging area of the electrical tree, including scanning electron microscope, micro-Raman analysis and energy spectrum analysis, etc., to obtain the microscopic characteristics of the electrical tree at different stages of development. Based on these, the growth mechanisms of electrical tree have been proposed, which provides a better understanding of the electrical treeing processes.

articleTitle: Analysis Method of Transformer Quality Event Feature Label Based on BERT
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Transformer is an indispensable main electrical equipment in power transmission and distribution system. A large number of typical quality event analysis reports are accumulated in daily operation and maintenance, most of which are unstructured descriptive text data. The records have distinct personal characteristics, and it is difficult to understand or analyze by means of automation. For solving the above problem, this paper proposed an analysis method for labeling transformer quality event features based on Bidirectional Encoder Representation from Transformers(BERT). Firstly, the transformer quality event manually extracted feature label is used as input for text vectorization, and the model parameters are obtained by repeatedly using the text get into BERT pre-training model. Then, a training method that changes each learning rate by gradual attenuation is proposed to optimize the model. K-means++ clustering algorithm was used to analysis and Figure out all kinds of quality events. Finally, an example analysis based on 452 actual transformer quality event analysis reports was conducted. The example results showed that the method proposed in this paper achieved a good correspondence between the feature labels of transformer quality events, and the accuracy reached 90%, which is which is at least 4.2% higher than that of the traditional machine learning text data mining technology.

articleTitle: Influence of Temperature on the Partial Discharge Inception Characteristics of Typical Insulation-shaping Components in Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: In this paper, the effect of temperature on the partial discharge inception characteristics of typical insulation-shaping components is demonstrated. The partial discharge test platform was established to test the typical insulation-shaping components of three manufacturers. The products of each manufacturer were tested for the partial discharge inception voltage and magnitude at five temperatures of 20°C 35°C, 50°C, 65°C and 80°C, and their distribution figures were drawn. Based on the test results, the partial discharge inception characteristics of the insulation-shaping components of the three manufacturers were compared, and the dispersion of the product data was analyzed. According to the analysis result, it can be concluded that the partial discharge inception voltage of typical insulation-shaping components decreases with the increase of temperature, and the discharge magnitude rise with the increase of temperature, and the performance of various insulation-shaping components of each manufacturer is different.

articleTitle: Comparison of Thermal and Moisture Effects of Hydroisomerized Non-cycloalkyl and Cycloalkyl Transformer Insulating Oil
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: With the rapid development of the national power industry, the traditional used cycloalkyl insulating oil used for transformers is unable to meet the demand of the power industry and the environment protection gradually, hence, new insulating oil is needed. But both cycloalky and non-cycloalky ones will fragment with the thermal, electrical and moisture stress. In this paper, the properties of cycloalkyl insulating oil and hydroisomeric non-cycloalkyl one are compared under thermal stress based on molecular simulation technique. The fragment products of cycloalkyl insulating oil and hydroisomeric non-cycloalkyl one are analyzed at 3000 K and different water mass fractions with ReaxFF reaction molecular dynamics software. The results show that the cycloalkyl insulating oil fragments more rapidly and the hydroisomeric non-cycloalkyl properties are more stable under the same conditions.

articleTitle: Study on the Distribution Range of Measurable Trap Depth Using Space Charge Measurement Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The measurement speed and spatial resolution are two key performances of space charge measurement methods, whose effect on measurable charge trap depth has never been discussed before. Based on the hopping model of space charge in the sample, a judgment criteria is proposed to analyze the accurate measurement of space charge information. Further calculation example indicates that, the measurable charge is in the trap depth range above 0.85 eV when single measurement time needs 1 s and spatial resolution is 10 $\mu$m in the PEA method. The studied sample characteristic and temperature can also affect the trap depth range. Meanwhile, the proposed criteria is also proper for the analyzation of other space charge measurement methods.

articleTitle: Study on Characteristics of Partial Discharge Caused by Micro-bubble in Insulating Oil
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: In the last few decades, Bubbling phenomenon grows to be a major concern for its insulation threats in oil-immersed facilities during dynamic rating or overloading. Formed bubbles with radius from tens to hundreds um could lead to partial discharge or even serious insulation failure. However, previous studies on bubble-induced discharge in insulating oil usually focused on millimeter size bubbles. The research to date has not been able to determine the real threat of micro-bubbles of tens to hundreds um of in oil. In this paper, the characteristics of partial discharge induced by micro-bubbles were investigated. The finding is unexpected and suggests that partial discharge inception electric field strength is significantly higher than the theoretical value, which shows tiny change with variation of bubbles radius. Besides, bubble radius is a significant factor on the number of partial discharge current pulses and the apparent charge. The number of current pulses induced by a single bubble could help to reveal the interaction mechanism between bubbles and discharges. Finally, the equation associating the apparent charge and bubble radius was fitted.

articleTitle: Partial Discharge Detection Technology of Live Ring Network Cabinet Based the 5G Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: A method to detect the PD signals in the ring net cabinet when it is powered on based the pulse current method and 5G cloud computing is proposed in this work. During the experiment, a live indicator is used and the operating condition of the ring network cabinet is considered. A better signal acquisition methods and signal processing algorithms are applied to realize 5G wireless transmission. Phase resolved pulse sequence (PRPS) and phase resolved partial discharge (PRPD) can be intuitively displayed on the screen. Six insulation defects are selected and the effectiveness of the method is verified. This method is conducive to monitoring the PD signal of the ring network cabinet in the field.

articleTitle: Development Characteristics of Partial Discharge of Basin-type Insulator for GIS Under AC Voltage
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Metal particles attached to the insulator surface will seriously distort the electric field along the surface, induce partial discharge and even cause flashover, which seriously threatens the normal operation of the equipment. The detection of partial discharge is one of the important means of insulation supervision. In this paper, the experimental platform of PD photoelectric joint diagnosis was built. The development characteristics of partial discharge of 126 kV basin-type insulator for GIS under AC voltage were studied. With the increase of the applied voltage, three stages were founded from the beginning of partial discharge to the approaching flashover. When the metal particles are located at different positions of the basin-type insulator, the change trend of the discharge amount with the voltage is the same, and both show a slow increase first and then an exponential increase trend.

articleTitle: The Defective Causes Analysis for a Batch of Current Transformers Based on Simulation Tests
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Recently, quality problems were found successively in more than ten current transformers (CTs), which were produced in a same batch, in Guangming switch station of Inner Mongolia province. Both the capacitance and dielectric loss did not meet the requirement of criteria. And the contents of dissolved gas in oil in those CTs exceeded the warming value. In order to explore the formative reasons of defects, the characteristics of defects in this batch of the transformers were sorted firstly. A typical CT which was used to be installed at an A-phase outgoing of the No.159 interval was selected for disassembly analysis. However, no abnormality was found in all parts of the transformer during the disassembling process. In view of this, two defective models were prepared by using the LB6-IIOW type of transformers separately. One of them was improper dried whereas the other was simply oil-immersed without using vacuum. The development process of defects in current transformer was studied. The simulation test showed that under the external applied voltage and current stresses, the capacitance and dielectric loss of models increased rapidly. And the dissolved gases were produced very fast in oil. H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> is the dominating dissolved gas followed by CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>. A small amount of C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> could be also found in oil. It was believed that the unsatisfactory vacuum immersion oil is the main cause for the failure of this batch of CTs. Based on this research, corresponding technical suggestions were put forward.

articleTitle: Cause analysis of line tripping caused by arrester protection failure
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: For the arrester fault of 220 kV overhead transmission line, the appearance inspection, insulation resistance, DC leakage current and 8 / 20 μ s impulse current tests were carried out on the problem arrester. The results showed that the appearance inspection and electrical test of the same manufacturer and the same batch of products all met the standard requirements. Combined with test and on-site inspection, it is believed that the reason for line tripping caused by the failure of arrester protection is due to the defects in the installation method. Suggestions on installation, operation and maintenance are put forward.

articleTitle: The Test Data of Multi-source Transmission and Transformation Equipment are Unified JSON Format File Generation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Objective: For multi-source transmission and transformation equipment transport inspection data into a standardized JSON format, easy for transport inspectors to collect, store, analysis. methods: To obtain the detection data of the transmission and transformation device through RS232 or USB drive and Bluetooth and transmit it to the intelligent analysis terminal, and use node.js to read and convert the experimental data stream into the standard JSON format according to the standard specification, and finally into the target file. Result: According to the multi-source instrument detection data type, the conversion kit was developed to generate a standard unified JSON file containing basic equipment information, nameplate information and test data. Conclusion: JSON is a simple data exchange format, the biggest feature is simplicity [1], with good self-description, easy to read, strong software-friendly, improve the operation of inspectors to analyze and store different types of variable power detection data efficiency.

articleTitle: Transient Overvoltage Simulation on Wind Farm in Mongolia Under Lightning Strokes
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Direct lightning strokes on wind turbine blade is one of the reason that results in transient overvoltage of the electrical equipment. The previous researches have shown that transient overvoltage development which is effected by lightning current parameters could cause breakdowns in low voltage circuit and equipment. In recent years, Mongolia has built several wind farms in areas with high capacity of wind energy resources. However, there is still uncertainty in the behavior of lightning protection system, specifically on wind turbines located in high elevated areas with unavailable lightning parameters. Based on the literatures, the studies using PSCAD/EMTDC software are presented to model existing wind farm as a test set under the influence of peak current and waveforms. Existing WT’s was well protected from lightning, however the simulation showed that probable of lightning current with high amplitudes could produce transient overvoltage to the electrical components at the stricken tower and grounding system plays an important role for lightning protection.

articleTitle: Research on DC Breakdown Characteristics for the Insulation of 10 kV AC XLPE Cables
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: It is of great significance to study the direct current (DC) breakdown characteristics of the alternating current (AC) cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) for converting AC XLPE cables into DC operation. The AC and DC breakdown experiments were carried out on 10 kV AC XLPE samples under three different dwell times (1 min, 5 min and 15 min). The characteristics between the breakdown electric field and the breakdown time under AC and DC voltage was obtained according to the date of breakdown experiments. The results show that the 1 h AC and DC breakdown electric field is 69.80 MV/m and 170.96 MV/m respectively, and the DC breakdown electric field is always higher than the AC breakdown electric field in the range of 1 h to 40 a.

articleTitle: Influence of the Defects in RIP bushings on Electric Field Distortion
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Epoxy resin impregnated paper (RIP) dry bushings are an important part of transformers. The defects in the core insulation will seriously threaten the safe operation of the substation. This paper studies the influence of different types of defects on the electric field distortion of the RIP bushings. Constructed a model of dry casing, and set up bubble, crack and water drop defects in the model to study the influence of defect development on electric field distortion. It is indicated that the bubble defects, crack defects, and damp defects have an important impact on the electric field. Among them, the larger ones have a more serious effect on the electric field distortion. In addition, if the defect is inside the epoxy insulation, and located relatively close to the current conduit, the degree of electric field distortion is much greater than in other locations.

articleTitle: Research on the Influences of Temperature on Frequency Domain Dielectric Spectroscopy of the ERIP Bushing Capacitor Core
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Epoxy resin impregnated paper (ERIP) bushing capacitor core is one of the main insulation part of the capacitance graded bushing. The insulating property of the ERIP bushing capacitor core is influenced by the temperature in the actual operation environmental. In order to explore the influence of temperature on frequency dielectric response of the ERIP bushing capacitor core, the frequency domain dielectric spectroscopy (FDS) is utilized for ERIP bushing capacitor core at different temperature, then a double relaxation Debye model is proposed in the paper. Firstly, the temperature experiment of ERIP bushing capacitor core is carried out, and the FDS test is performed on the bushing core at 20°C, 40°C, 60°C, 80°C and 100°C, respectively. Secondly, the FDS spectrum of the dielectric loss factor (tanδ) and the real and imaginary parts of the complex capacitance are plotted at different temperature. Finally, the influences of temperature on FDS test of ERIP bushing capacitor core are analyzed based on a double relaxation Debye model. The test results and analysis indicated that the entire spectrum of tanδ, the imaginary part of the complex capacitance are shown to shift toward the positive vertical direction and move to the high frequency. A good fitness result is obtained by the double relaxation Debye model, and the degree of fit on the data exceeds 90%. The high-frequency dielectric constant, interfacial polarization loss and dipole polarization loss can be made up for the real part of the complex capacitance. These conclusions can provide a mathematical model for the ERIP bushing capacitor core, which will be supportive for ageing state of bushing core insulation.

articleTitle: Analysis of Thermo-electric Coupled Simulation for 10 kV AC XLPE Cable under Different DC Topologies and Laying Modes
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: This research aims to provide a theoretical reference for the 10 kV AC cable under the DC operation. To study the DC operation parameters of the AC cable in different laying methods and DC topologies, the temperature field, flow field, and electric field coupled simulation models are developed according to the parameters of the typical 10 kV three-core XLPE cable. The temperature field, flow field, steady electric field, and transient electric field of the cable under DC operation are obtained by simulation. The cable-laying methods consisting of soil, pipeline, and trench under the bipole, monopole, and triple DC topologies are analyzed. The results show that the cable in the trench and tripole DC operation has the highest ampacity, while the cable in the pipeline and monopole DC operation has the lowest ampacity. The range of the DC voltage levels of the cable in the aforementioned laying modes and DC topologies is ±10~11 kV. The maximum transmission power of the cable in the trench and monopole DC operation is the highest, while that of the cable in the pipeline and bipole DC operation is the lowest. The maximum transmission power of the AC cable significantly increases under DC operation.

articleTitle: Study on Combination Scheme of Cable Laying and Fire Prevention Measures in High Voltage Cable Trench
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: With the rapid development of power construction, the number of substations is increasing, the application of cable trench is more and more widely, and the fire safety of cable trench has been paid attention to. For exploring the influence of cable laying mode on cable fire spread in cable trench, eight kinds of combined scheme models of cable trench fire prevention were established. From three aspects of cable arrangement mode, cable layer spacing, and relative position of cable and fire barrier, the variation laws of temperature and gas concentration in cable trench with time after fire in different combination schemes were compared and analyzed to select the cable laying and fire prevention methods that were conducive to the safe operation of the cable trench. The research results show that the scheme of parallel arrangement and five layers arrangement of cables and laying the fireproof partition under the cable is conducive to reducing the loss of cable trench fire and restraining the spread of cable fire.

articleTitle: Relationship Between Porosity and Dielectric Constant and Tensile Strength of Insulating Paper
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: It is found that when the structural properties of insulating paper are changed, its electrical properties also change significantly, but the mechanism is not clear, which makes us unable to choose the best structural parameters. Therefore, this paper starts from the porosity structure parameter to explore its influence on the dielectric constant and tensile strength of insulating paper. The results show that with the increase of the porosity of the insulating paper, the fiber content in the insulating paper decreases, so the dielectric constant and tensile strength decrease. In addition, the smaller the average pore size of the insulation paper and the smaller the matrix density of the fiber, the smaller the dielectric constant will be even the porosity is close; The higher the matrix density of insulation paper is, the higher the tensile strength is.

articleTitle: Discharge Fault Identification of Polluted Insulators Based on Wavelet Packet Transform Entropy Features
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The detection and type identification of defects in the external insulation of electrical equipment is an important part of high-voltage insulation condition assessment. UV pulse detection technology is used to detect and analyze the discharges by using UV sensors. In this paper, we propose a method to identify the defects of polluted insulator discharge based on the entropy feature of wavelet packet transform. The wavelet packet transform is used to decompose and reconstruct the UV pulse signal of the polluted insulator discharge and extract the three-dimensional time-frequency distribution of the signal for time-frequency analysis, extract the wavelet packet entropy features of the signal in the time-frequency domain, and classify the two discharge types of corona and arc using classifiers such as support vector machine (SVM). In order to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm proposed in this paper, a surface discharge test device was set up in the laboratory, and experiments were conducted to classify the corona and arc discharge types of ceramic insulators, which were detected by UV pulse sensors. The results show that the recognition rate of identifying the two discharge states of corona and arc is as high as 95% using the feature extraction method proposed in this paper. Meanwhile, the detection system can realize long-term online detection of external insulation discharge and can be extended to substation and switchgear detection.

articleTitle: Equivalence Analysis of Transmission Line Ice Coating Reduced-scale Test Based on Finite Element Simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Reduced-scale test is a verification method often used in engineering practice. The design of reduced-scale model is the key to the success of the test. The basic principle is that the main test data measured by the model and prototype in the test are similar or meet a certain proportion. Based on the idea of digital twin, the digital twin model of transmission line is established. The transmission line is simulated and analyzed in this paper. By using the finite element simulation platform, the reduced-scale model of two-span transmission line and its prototype finite element simulation model are established. Under uniform icing load and non-uniform icing load, the vertical span of the line and the tension at the same point on the line are compared, which are important mechanical parameters for weighing method in on-line icing monitoring of transmission line. And the mapping relationship between the reduced-scale model and the prototype and the similarity between them are verified.

articleTitle: Diagnosis and Cause Analysis of a Short Circuit Fault of a Grounding Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Large power transformer is one of the core equipment in the power system, The accident of transformer damage caused by external short circuit has become the primary cause of power transformer accidents. This article is aimed at a short-circuit fault of a grounding transformer in a substation, Conduct insulation resistance and DC resistance tests on fault grounding transformers, at the same time, the disintegration work is carried out, It is found that the insulation problem of groundingtransformer body coil and interturn and interlayer short circuit occur. the high temperature generated by the short-circuit current vaporizes the insulating material, And cause the epoxy shell to rupture and catch fire. The carbon produced by the fire reduces the insulation level between the high-voltage terminals, Then an electric arc causes a three-phase short circuit..

articleTitle: Fabry-Perot Interference Based Fiber Optic Sensing Method for Partial Discharge and Fast Temperature Change in Power Transformers
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: To simplify the installation and wiring of sensors inside transformers and the structure of light source and demodulation system of fiber optic sensing system, a Fabry-Perot (F-P) interference-based fiber optic sensing method for partial discharge and fast temperature change in power transformers is proposed. The joint sensing of partial discharge and oil temperature change is realized based on narrowband laser and photodetector. A fiber optic F-P ultrasonic sensor with resonant frequency at 153 kHz was designed using a vibration model of a single-sided contact diaphragm with liquid to achieve sensing of 191.23 pC in oil. Based on the same sensor, a temperature change detection method based on the DC component of the F-P cavity output light intensity was investigated. The experimental results show that the DC component of the sensor output light intensity will periodically appear as a Gaussian pulse reversed along the X-axis which will pass through a minimum point when the temperature changes. The faster the temperature changes, the more times the DC component passes the minimum point in a period of time. Therefore, the number of the DC component of the sensor's output light intensity passing the minimum point in a period of time can be counted to reflect the rapidity of the internal oil temperature change of the transformer.

articleTitle: Calculation and Analysis of Stray Losses and Temperature Rise Distribution in Tank Walls of High Impedance Power Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Accurate calculation of magnetic leakage field and stray losses reduction for eliminating local overheating in structural components of power transformer plays an important role in transformer design. An electromagnetic-thermal bidirectional coupling method and three dimensional (3-D) nonlinear finite element analysis technology is adopted to calculate and analyze the effects of different shielding schemes on the stray loss reduction and temperature rise distribution in tank walls. The power transformer with series reactor coil built-in to realize high impedance is regarded as research object, which type is SFSZ-240MVA/220kV. Finally, the load loss test and temperature rise test validate the determined leakage flux control scheme.

articleTitle: Study on the Evolutionary Mechanism of Metal Particle Defect Development Inside GIS
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: GIS internal particles have become the main factor affecting the safe and stable operation of GIS, but the development and evolution mechanism of GIS internal particle defects is still unclear. In this paper, by building a 220kV GIS test platform, using the UHF local discharge detection method to study the development of GIS internal free particle defects evolution mechanism, the test found that when the voltage rises to the starting discharge voltage, free metal free particles produce continuous partial discharge, but when the voltage level for a period of time, the number of partial discharge will gradually reduce until a more stable state. When the metal particles enter the low field strength region, the electric field strength is not strong enough to make the free metal particles continue to move, and if the electric field distortion caused by it is still able to maintain the generation of partial discharge, the free metal particles will be stabilized.

articleTitle: Influence of Corona Space Charge on Subsequent Streamer Inception from Horizontal Conductors during Lightning Attachment Process
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: the space charge generate by the corona discharge near the UHVDC overhead transmission lines can distort the electric field distribution under thunderstorms. this paper presents a numerical model to estimate the corona space charge produced by horizontal conductors in response the electric field generated by both thundercloud and downward leader. Secondly, the corona space charge development process from ground conductors was obtained. The transition process of corona discharge to subsequent streamer is analyzed. the inhibition effect of the space charge layer on the subsequent streamer initiation was calculated by considering different conductor diameters. It is concluded that there is an optimal diameter for horizontal conductors which can ensure a superior capability to launch subsequent streamers, which should achieve a corona-free condition under the electric field of thundercloud.

articleTitle: Research on Vibration of Transformer Core Based on Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The transformer will generate a lot of noise during operation. The main sources include the vibration noise caused by the deformation of the winding and the noise generated by the vibration of the transformer core. The main source of the vibration of the transformer is the magnetostrictive effect of the core. Starting from the actual operating conditions of the transformer, this paper constructs a vibration model of the transformer by coupling the electrical, magnetic, and structural physical fields of the transformer, and conducts simulation analysis through finite element software. Through simulation, we can obtain the magnetic flux distribution of the transformer during operation and the deformation and displacement of the transformer core due to magnetostriction, and we can also obtain the normal acceleration distribution on the surface of the core. It lays a good foundation for further research on the sound field distribution of the transformer, and provides a basis for optimizing the placement of the transformer vibration sensor.

articleTitle: Analysis and Suggestions on MOA Protection Failure of Overhead Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: As one of the main technical means of lightning protection, MOA has been widely used in overhead lines in southern China. However, in recent years, line arrester failures have occurred in many places. In this paper, the appearance inspection, insulation resistance, DC leakage current, 8/20 $\mu\mathbf{s}$ impulse current and dissection test were carried out on the arrester in a power grid company. The results showed that the appearance inspection and electrical test of the same manufacturer and the same batch of products all met the standard requirements. It was found that there was no non air insulation filler between the valve piece a of the test object and the outer epoxy cylinder. Based on the analysis of the test and field inspection, it was considered that one of the reasons for the failure of the arrester protection was the design defect, one was the production quality control was not in place, and the other was the defect in the installation mode. In view of three different types of faults, suggestions are put forward from design selection, production process control, installation, operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: Impedance Parameter Analysis and Electromagnetic Influence Modeling of Three Phase Cable Adjacent to Metal Pipeline
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: When the high-voltage AC cable is laid adjacent to metal pipeline, the electromagnetic influence may be generated which is related to the safe and stable operation of metal pipeline. In this paper, an electromagnetic model of three-phase cable and metal pipeline laying nearby is set up. Based on the simplified calculation formula of earth loop impedance, the impedance parameters of three-phase cable and metal pipeline are calculated. The difference between the impedances under different layouts is compared. Finally, the influence of relevant factors on impedance parameters is analyzed.

articleTitle: Space Charge Distribution Characteristics of Pressboard Modified by Nano-TiO2 at Different Temperature Gradients
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Since the converter transformer has complex operating conditions, the charge accumulation is easy to occur on the oil/paper interface, which leads to insulation failure. The space charge is one of vital factors, which affects the electrical performance of oil/paper insulation system. In order to measure the space charge, the pulsed electro-acoustic (PEA) method is used in this paper, and the distribution characteristics of space charge for the pressboard modified by nano-TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> are analyzed at disparate temperature gradients. In addition, the influence mechanism on temperature for space charge distribution of oil-pressboard modified by nano-TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> is discussed. It is found that the temperature gradient can result in the space charge distribution by increasing the mobility of different carriers. The results show that the hetero-charge accumulate more at the low temperature side (at bottom electrode) because of the temperature gradient, while at the high temperature side (at top electrode) only a small amount of homo-charge accumulates. The insulating pressboards modified by nano-TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> can effectively suppress the space charge accumulation behaviors.

articleTitle: Research on the Solution to Metrology Testing and Traceability System Solution for Digital Electrical Metering System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: In order to solve both the testing and the “tracing” problems of digital electricity meter, the concepts and equipment of “Analog Merging Unit”, “Computational Analog Reference Meter”, “Digital Synthetic Analog Power Source” was introduced, and three kinds of thorough testing methods, i.e., “Standard Source Comparison Method”, “Reference Meter Comparison Method”, and “Comprehensive Comparison Method”, as well as the corresponding complete standard transfer & “tracing” systems was provided. By doing so, the testing and the “tracing” of digital electricity meter can be reasonably included into the standard transfer & “tracing” system of the traditional watt-hour meter, so that digital electrical energy metering can adopt the analog metering system completely. Then, technical problems of the testing and the “tracing” of digital electricity meter can be solved concisely, scientifically, and economically. The unity of digital and analog electrical energy metering systems, inherits the uninterrupted continuity, stability, and seriousness of the standard transfer & “tracing” system of electrical energy metering, and has certain logic, rationality and conscientiousness, and also reduces the risk of digital power energy metering system. Getting rid of the “digital” part during digital electrical energy metering process is an innovation and development for electrical energy metering technology.

articleTitle: Design and Application of a Wireless Intelligent Detection System for Leakage Current of MOA
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Metal oxide arrester (MOA) online monitoring systems are increasingly used in smart substations, but there are also some problems in project operation, such as difficulty in measuring reference voltage, inaccurate monitoring data, poor integration. In order to solve the above problems, this paper developed a high-precision wireless intelligent detection system for reference voltage and leakage current of MOA. It directly measures the bus voltage on the secondary side of the CVT, and transmit wireless signals for a long time as a phase reference for the whole station to use. The leakage current measurement is started at the voltage zero-crossing, and the dielectric loss angle is calculated through Hanning windowed interpolation fast Fourier transform (FFT) algorithm. The voltage and current measurement circuit contains automatic gain adjustment functions and self-calibration functions and the changes caused by the sensor and filter can be corrected by itself. Through comparative experiments in the laboratory, we have proved the effectiveness of the wireless intelligent detection system.

articleTitle: Decomposition Process of SF6 with Residual O2 under Over-Thermal Fault
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Partial over-thermal fault may occur in gas insulated equipment during operation due to poor contact or overload. SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas insulating medium is stable under normal conditions, while it begins to decompose into sulfur fluorides when the temperature exceeds 300 degree Celsius. Especially when moisture and oxygen exist in the chamber, the decomposition products further react with them to form stable products such as SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, SOF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, COF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, SOF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>, HF and so on, the reaction processes of which are irreversible. However, the mechanism of O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> on the decomposition of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> and the formation of the products is still unclear. The paper focuses on the reaction processes involving oxygen and analyses the role O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> plays in the decomposition of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Dynamic Cooperative Control System for Cable Laying
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: In the traditional underground cable laying, the cable laying method of manually controlling the start and stop of tractor and conveyor has some problems, such as low automation degree, unadjustable speed and easy deformation of cable. Aiming at the above problems, this paper designs a dynamic cooperative control system for cable laying based on PLC. The system adopts the master and slave station control mode, and carries on the linkage control to the electric line release frame, electric roller and tractor, and realizes the synchronous start and stop. Electric boxes are arranged in the cable laying path successively, and the influence of voltage drop on power supply is eliminated by the power supply from head to tail. The control system is divided into four layers, with the main station S7-1500 PLC as the control core, and each layer carries out data transmission by means of communication. The upper information system is at the top level, which sends instructions to the PLC of the master station and receives the cable laying data fed back by it. Master station PLC can receive the instructions issued by the same layer HMI to control the slave station PLC; The hardware driver is controlled by S7-1200 PLC of the slave station. The field test results of the system show that the cable laying speed of the system is adjustable, and the starting, running and braking are stable, which not only improves the automation degree of the cable laying, but also reduces the risk of cable damage.

articleTitle: Study on DC Rod-Plate Discharge Under Atmospheric Pressure in Air
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Based on the theory of gas discharge, the principle of rod plate electrode discharge in atmospheric pressure air is analyzed, and the hydrodynamic equation describing gas discharge is established. The generation mechanism and spatial distribution of particles in the discharge channel are analyzed with numerical simulation and simulation results. In gas discharge with long air gap, the space charge produced by electron avalanche has a great influence on the discharge process and the distribution of charged particles, and the charged particles are mainly concentrated in the range of millimeter from the tip of the rod; In steady state, a large number of stable charged particles are distributed in the gap, which is of great significance for the study of stable plasma generation at atmospheric pressure.

articleTitle: Study on Lightning Performance of Composite Cross-arm Towers in Ultra-High Voltage Transmission Lines Considering Multiple Factors
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Composite cross-arms have a broad application in the transmission line project, however, research on the lightning performance of composite cross-arm towers in ultra-high voltage (UHV) transmission lines is rare in the literatures. This paper constructs a model of composite cross-arm using EMTP software. Considering the characteristics of composite cross-arm tower, Lightning back-strike performance in 500kV double-circuit transmission lines under different grounding resistance, tower height and voltage phase angle is investigated. The result shows that the model is valid, which provides a basis for the application of composite cross-arm towers in UHV line design.

articleTitle: Simulation of Charge Transport Characteristics of Polypropylene
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Polypropylene is a potential environment-friendly insulation material for high voltage DC cable due to its excellent electrical properties. The characteristics of space charge injection and accumulation under DC voltage are important factors of dielectric breakdown. Based on the bipolar charge transport model, this paper used finite element simulation software to simulate the dynamic evolution process of space charge and electric field distortion characteristics with the increase of voltage boosting time. The simulation result indicates that the electric field distortion in polypropylene is caused by the accumulation of charge injection, and the electric field distortion becomes obvious when the voltage reaches a certain threshold with the increase of time.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Method for Transformer Windings Based on Residual Neural Network and State Code
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Currently, methods for power transformer winding fault diagnosis are still less intelligent. And there are few studies on its fault localization. This paper proposes a state code suitable for transformer intelligent fault diagnosis, which is combined with residual neural network for fault localization of transformer windings. First, obtain transformer winding frequency response data of different states based on pspice simulation. Next, the Pearson correlation coefficient of the FR data and the fingerprint is calculated using windowing calculation method to obtain the feature sequence dataset. Then, map the value of the one-dimensional feature sequence to the track of the space filling curve to obtain the two-dimensional state code dataset. Finally, the dataset is used for transfer training and verification of the residual neural network constructed based on the diagnostic scenario in this paper. Finally, the accuracy of the method proposed in this paper has an average increase of 5.43% over the traditional machine learning methods, reaching 94.44%.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Causes of the Formation of the Pole of the Frequency Response Curve of the Transformer Winding
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The frequency response method is currently one of the main methods for offline detection of transformer winding deformation defects. Although the characteristic parameters and diagnostic criteria of this method have matured, there is a lack of research on the formation of the extreme points in the frequency response curve. This paper will use the lumped parameter two-port network model and the uniform transmission line theoretical distributed parameter model to analyze the causes of the poles of the winding frequency response curve in detail. On the one hand, the resonance law is used to analyze the voltage characteristics of the winding, and on the other hand, the propagation process and law of the electromagnetic wave inside the winding are studied, and interpret the corresponding frequency response curve with the superposition of wave refraction.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis Model of SF₆ Circuit Breaker Based on FNN Improved by GA
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The traditional fault diagnosis methods of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> circuit breakers lack systematicity, which are intricate and time-consuming in fault detection and maintenance. A fault diagnosis model of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> circuit breaker based on fuzzy neural network improved by genetic algorithm is established to solve the similar problems. In this paper, an online fault diagnosis method for SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> circuit breaker based on fuzzy neural network improved by genetic algorithm is established. This method adopted the characteristic data of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> circuit breakers to build a fault diagnosis model which is trained by inputting parameters, including the decomposition products of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas in the circuit breaker and the temperature, pressure and density, to diagnose the corresponding faults. Finally, the fault diagnosis model of fuzzy neural network improved by genetic algorithm compared with other diagnosis models in terms of training time and accuracy. The simulation results show that the proposed fault diagnosis model is more efficient and accurate than other available methods. The fault diagnosis model has also been applied to the online monitoring technology of the smart substation with good operations.

articleTitle: Research on Design and Application of Portable UHV Zero Value Insulator Detection Device
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The regulations require that when installing UHV porcelain insulators, the insulation resistance should be measured with an insulation resistance meter no less than 5000V, and the resistance value of the insulator should be no less than 500M $\Omega$ under dry conditions. Traditional insulator zero detection methods include insulation resistance meter, simple pulse device, spark fork method and voltage distribution method. Due to the above methods, the test voltage is too low, the device is bulky, the operation is complicated, or the accuracy is greatly affected by the external environment, resulting in unsatisfactory application effects. For this reason, this article mainly studies a portable insulator zero value test device, and meets the following technical requirements: output voltage above 60kV, deviation less than 5% test range 0 $\sim$ 5000M $\Omega$, resolution: 1M $\Omega$, error no more than 10 % weight no more than 3kg; The number of continuous use of a single charge of the power supply is not less than 5000 times. The device is small and portable, with high accuracy, which is able to detect the insulators one by one without dismantling the wooden crates.

articleTitle: Safety Analysis of Live Working on ±500kV Composite Crossarm Line
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The composite cross-arm structure is quite different from the conventional tower, which has a great impact on the safe distance of live working, the entering equipotential method, and the electric field protection requirements of workers. This paper analyzes the influence of ± 500kV composite crossarm on the safety of live working through experiments and simulation calculations. The minimum approach distance and the minimum combined gap distance of live working on the ± 500kV composite cross-arm line are 3.5m and 3.9m, which are 0.1m larger than the conventional tower requirements. On composite crossarm line, we can enter the equipotential along the composite crossarm. When entering and exiting equipotential along the composite crossarm, the maximum electric field strength on the worker’s body appears at the head and shoulder. The results of this paper can assure the safety of live working on ± 500kV composite crossarm lines.

articleTitle: Adaptive Inspection of Submarine Cable for Operating Environment Based on Remote Operated Vehicle
