publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Regularly, inspections about the operating environment of submarine cables could help to find risk points such as exposing, suspending, and weakened mechanical protection of submarine cables, which facilitates timely adjustment of operation and maintenance strategies and measures to repair the mechanical protection to prevent the cables from being damaged by external forces. Based on PID and fuzzy control theory, a series of automatic control technologies such as auto cable tracking, auto depth, auto attitude, auto pitch, auto heading, auto positioning, etc. of Remote Operated Vehicle are proposed, which can be automatically controlled according to the direction of submarine cable routing, submarine topography and environmental changes. So as adjust the attitude of the Remote Operated Vehicle, realize the adaptive detection of the operating environment of the submarine cable, and it helps to improve the intelligence of the detection operation, and reduce the excessive intervention from the pilots during the detection process. This technology was successfully applied for the 500kV submarine cable inspection of Hainan Interconnection Project in 2019. The Remote Operated Vehicle detected along the submarine cables routing under the strong cross-current or fixed-point hovering. In this detection, several exposing and suspending of the cable was successfully found.

articleTitle: Study on Linear Metal Particle Motion and Electrode-coating in DC GIL
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The surface charge distribution and electric field force of linear metal particle in DC were studied, and effect of electrode coating on the lift force of linear particles was discussed. In order to study the experimental phenomenon of linear free conductor particle motion, the experimental device and observation system of free conductor particle are designed. Based on the micro transport equations of positive and negative ions, finite element simulation software was used to establish the linear particles with different cross-section shapes and the charge and lift force models of electrode coating particles under DC.

articleTitle: Influence of particle size on Lichtenberg Figure technique for surface charge characterization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The Lichtenberg Figure technique is a method that can directly observe the surface charge distribution of the insulating material. It is widely used in the observation of the charge at the gas-solid interface and the study of the discharge mechanism. A needle-plate electrode was used to corona charge the polyimide film. The influence of the particle size on the spatial resolution of the surface charge measurement presented by the Lichtenberg Figure was studied by selecting dust of different particle sizes. A surface potential measurement system was constructed for verifying whether the dust affects the original charge distribution on the insulating surface. The results show that as the particle size of the dust becomes smaller, the accuracy of the Lichtenberg Figure is improved, and the influence of the dust on the original charge distribution can be reduced through the improvement of the test method.

articleTitle: Study on The Effect of Dielectric Film on Gap Breakdown Voltage under DC Voltage in Air, SF6 and SF6/N2 Mixture
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The roughness of the electrode surface and the coating of dielectric film on the electrode surface will affect the insulation performance of the gas. In this paper, an experimental platform of spherical-plate electrode is designed. The surface roughness of spherical electrode is $0.05 \mu \mathrm{m}, 0.8 \mu \mathrm{m}, 3.2 \mu \mathrm{m}, 6.3 \mu \mathrm{m}$ and $12.5 \mu \mathrm{m}$. Polyimide dielectric films with thickness of $25 \mu \mathrm{m}$, 50 $\mu \mathrm{~m}, 75 \mu \mathrm{m}$ and $100 \mu \mathrm{m}$ are prepared. Experiments are carried out in air, SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> and SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>/N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> mixtures under DC negative polarity respectively by changing the roughness of the spherical electrode and the thickness of the dielectric film. The results show that the rougher the spherical electrode is, the lower the air gap breakdown voltage is. Coating dielectric film can improve the adverse effects of rough electrodes, and the gap breakdown voltage increases with the increase of film thickness.

articleTitle: Research on Moisture Characteristics of Mechanism Case for Outdoor Circuit Breaker under Different Rain Conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Mechanism case for outdoor circuit breaker is in a harsh environment for a long time, and it is easy to cause internal water ingress due to heavy rain, which may bring short-circuit, grounding or other faults. However, there are no relevant research on moisture characteristics of mechanism case for outdoor circuit breaker under different rain conditions. The internal water inside mechanism case brings great safety risks to the operation of circuit breaker. In this paper, to study moisture characteristics of mechanism case for outdoor circuit breaker under different rain conditions, natural rainfall and artificial simulation of heavy rain environment are used. By monitoring temperature and humidity changes and internal water inflow in mechanism case, moisture characteristics of door and vent of mechanism case are studied, and waterproof effect of different sealing materials is analyzed.

articleTitle: Application of Converter Transformer Defect Detection Based on Transformer Integrated Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: This paper introduces an abnormal oil color spectrum of converter transformer during commissioning of UHVDC transmission project. The application of transformer integrated monitoring system based on ultrasonic local discharge, UHF local discharge and high frequency local discharge integrated software and hardware is used to detect and locate the floating potential discharge defects of converter transformer. The rheologic voltage is carried out by endoscope to locate and other parts The method of in-chip inspection verifies the feasibility of the integrated monitoring system for finding similar discharge defects of converter transformer, and provides an effective detection method for fast and accurate detection of transformer defects.

articleTitle: Research on the extraction method of high-voltage circuit breaker vibration signal based on IVMD
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The vibration of the high-voltage circuit breaker operating mechanism can indirectly reflect its mechanical motion state. In order to effectively extract the vibration signal characteristic quantity, the vibration signal of the circuit breaker is firstly analyzed theoretically as a series of simple harmonic superposition formation. For the characteristics of randomness and non-smoothness of the vibration signal, VMD (Variational Mode Decomposition) is recommended for calculation and analysis. The concept of quality factor is introduced to optimize the VMD. Finally, via the comparison of example simulation, IVMD can separate each component mode of the vibration signal effectively, which can solve the decomposition modal overlap problem of EMD.

articleTitle: Design of GIS High Voltage Measurement System Based on Pockels Electro-Optic Effect
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Gas insulated switchgear (GIS) is a totally enclosed equipment, which the high voltage can’t be measured according to normal operation. The detection of high voltage can only be operated by high voltage live display device. This paper puts forward an improvement scheme for the traditional high voltage live display device. The optical voltage sensor is proposed to replace the traditional sensor for measurement, and the finite element software ANSYS Maxwell 16.0 is used to simulate and analyze the field strength distribution of the points to be measured, so as to determine the best installation position of the sensor probe. The software is used to process the nonlinear signal, which improves the accuracy of voltage measurement. This research provides a new idea for measuring the internal high voltage of Gas-Insulated Switchgear. -

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on Interference of UHV AC Downlead of Tension Insulator-string
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Based on the actual situation of the construction of the 1000kV extra-high voltage(UHV) line from ZhangBei to Xiong’An, this paper analyzes the causes of interference between downlead of tension insulator-string and other fittings. And proposes solutions such as increasing the split spacing, improving installation methods, and developing new fittings to ensure Smooth application in UHV projects and long-term operation safety, and provide experience for future design and operation.

Author Keywords: development of new type of hardware

articleTitle: Progress in Weak Discharge Detection Based on PMTs
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Weak partial discharge detection can be used to assess the insulation performance of high-voltage electrical devices. Optical detection technology featuring photomultiplier tubes (PMTs) enables the detection of weak discharge in high-voltage electrical equipment by detecting the light radiation generated during the discharging period. The paper reviews the principle of the detection of weak discharge based on PMTs and introduces details of the research in optical detection technology of weak discharge recently. Finally, this paper also summarizes the potential problems in the application of PMTs and possible prospects of this technology.

articleTitle: Decomposition Characteristics of C4 F7 N/CO2 Gas Mixture at Different Gas Pressure
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: In recent years, C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf> N gas has been considered as one of the most promising alternative gases for SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> due to its excellent insulation and environmental performance. At present, there are still many imperfections in the research of C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf> N decomposition characteristics, which make it difficult to be widely used in power equipment. In this paper, the kinetic model of C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf> N decomposition with different pressure is established on the Reaxff molecular dynamics method. It is found that the decomposition rate of C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf> N and CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> increases with the increase of air pressure, and the C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> NF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> and C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> NF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> generated by the decomposition will undergo secondary decomposition at high temperature, while the decomposition rate of C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf> N to produce CF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> and F will increase with the increase of air pressure. The production rate of free radicals such as CF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, CN, CF, CNF and CF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> increases with the increase of air pressure, while the formation of C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</inf> is inhibited under high pressure. The results of this paper can provide some theoretical reference for C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf> N on application in electrical equipment.

articleTitle: Research on the Aging Mechanism of Insulation Paper of Converter Transformer Based on Molecular Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: With the increase in the demand for long-distance and large-capacity transmission, more and more Ultra High Voltage Direct Current (UHVDC) projects are put into construction, and the research on the insulation of the converter transformer of its core equipment has become very important. Based on molecular dynamics, this paper establishes an insulating paper model, and applies force fields such as COMPASS II, ReaxFF6.0 to simulate the actual working environment of the insulating paper, so as to analyze the diffusion of small molecules in the insulating paper; explain the effect of electric field on the main chemical bond length of cellobiose; analyze the content change of main products and describe the formation path of main products. Intends to explore the aging mechanism of insulating paper from a microscopic point of view.

articleTitle: Effect of sample preparation methods on space charge behavior and dielectric properties of polypropylene nanocomposites
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The accumulation of space charge in high-voltage DC cable insulation is the key problem leading to the insulation fault. Nano-silica (SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) and nano-alumina (Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>) doping methods are commonly used to improve the space charge performance of polypropylene (PP). In this paper, the dielectric spectra and space charge distribution of nano-SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/PP composites and nano-Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>/PP composites prepared by solution method and blending method were tested. Relative dielectric constant of the composites prepared by the solution method is higher than that of pure PP, which of composites prepared by the blending method is similar to that of pure PP. As the frequency increases, the dielectric loss factor shows a downward trend. After the addition of nanoparticles, the cathodic homopolar charge is obviously suppressed, and the inhibition effect of solution method is more obvious than that of blending method, which is related to the dispersion degree of nanoparticles in the samples prepared by the two methods. It is proved that the addition of nanoparticles can reduce the space charge in the composites and can achieve the effect of restraining the space charge. the better the dispersion of nanoparticles in the matrix, the better the inhibition effect.

articleTitle: Characteristics of Wind Swing of Carbon Fiber Composite Core Conductor Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Carbon fiber composite conductors (CFCC) have a wide potential application prospect in the capacity expansion project. But its characteristics of wind swing are not clear, which is not conducive to its popularization. In this paper, A dynamic model of transmission line was established, and the same type of aluminum conductor steel reinforced (ACSR) was selected for comparative study. The minimum interphase distance of the conductors and the wind swing angle of the insulator string under three kinds of wind were calculated. The simulated results show that the wind swing responses of CFCC are different under different wind patterns, and the minimum interphase distance may occur between the B-C phases or the A- B phases in different range of span. It was found that the swing angle in the CFCC lines was slightly larger than that in the ACSR lines, and the swing of insulators is the most serious in gust, followed by fluctuating wind and steady wind. Therefore, the influence of gust and fluctuating wind should be fully considered in the design of CFCC lines, and measures to prevent wind swing should be strengthened when installing CFCC in the old ACSR lines.

articleTitle: Blind Separation of Transformer Vibration Signal Based on Sensitive IMFs
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The vibration signal measured from the wall of the transformer oil tank is a mixture of various vibration source signals, and it is difficult to extract the characteristics of the transformer vibration signal and fault diagnosis. In this paper, a blind separation method of transformer vibration signal based on sensitive IMF is proposed aiming at the problem that the single-channel transformer vibration signal is difficult to separate. First, this paper analyzes the transformer vibration characteristics, and then the Intrinsic Mode Function (IMF) decomposed by the Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) algorithm is screened and reconstructed based on the sensitive factor. The VMD algorithm is combined with the Fast Independent Component Analysis (FastICA) algorithm to separate the vibration signal. The method is verified by constructing a simulation signal according to the transformer vibration characteristics, and the method is applied to separate the transformer vibration signal to prove the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Development of FBG Transformer Vibration Sensor Based on Cantilever Beam Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Power transformer is the core equipment of the power network, and vibration detection is an important technical means to analyze the mechanical state of the inner winding and iron core of the transformer. Compared with the traditional vibration sensor, the optical fiber vibration sensor has the advantages of anti-electromagnetic interference, easy reuse and high sensitivity. This paper designed a FBG vibration sensor based on the structure of cantilever beam, and based on the theory analysis and COMSOL simulation design the sensor structure vibration picking, improves the sensor sensitivity of low frequency vibration of transformer, set the edge spectrum of fiber grating demodulation system, simplifying the system structure, has realized the sensing of low frequency vibration signal. Based on the shaking table, the measured resonant frequency of the sensor is 180Hz, and the sensitivity at the resonant point is 14.09V/g. The sensor has good linearity at 100 Hz and can detect vibration signals lower than 0.0176g.

articleTitle: Research on Leakage Flux Control and Stray Loss Calculation on Metal Structure of Ultra High Voltage Autotransformer with Large Capacity
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Regarding the first 750 kV ultra high voltage (UHV) autotransformer with the largest single column capacity of 50MVA all around the world as the research object, which is developed and manufactured by our company, the advanced finite element analysis technology is adopted to calculate the three dimensional leakage magnetic field and stray losses on the structural components. In order to prevent local overheating and decrease stray loss, the matching distance between magnetic shunts of active part and yoke step, the slotting of clamping frame and the arrangement scheme of tank shielding are mainly studied. The effectiveness of the optimal scheme is verified by test results, showing that it has good consistency and the calculation accuracy meets the requirements of engineering application.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis on Three-Dimensional Temperature Profile of Valve-Side Resin Impregnated Paper Bushing for ± 800 kV Converter Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: In UHV DC transmission lines, the converter transformer resin impregnated paper (RIP) bushing operates under high voltage and high current conditions, and at the same time is severely tested by various stresses such as electricity, heat and force. Although RIP bushing meets the requirements of the non-oil design of the valve hall, it has the disadvantages of poor heat dissipation and serious heat generation. At present, with the improvement of the voltage level of UHV lines in China, heating problem is getting more serious. It is of great significance to study the heat and heat dissipation characteristics of converter transformer valve-side RIP bushing for promoting the localization of power equipment. In this paper, the temperature field distribution of ± 800kV valve-side RIP bushing is simulated by three-dimensional coupled electromagnetic-thermal-fluid analysis method, considering the influence of heat conduction, convective heat transfer and thermal radiation, and the results had been compared with the actual temperature rise test. The study findings can provide calculation basis for the design of valve-side RIP bushing of converter transformer.

articleTitle: Simulation and Experimental Research on Ampacity of Submarine Cables
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: In this paper, 220 kV and 500 square sheathed cable cores are studied. The temperature field distribution and current of the submarine cable are studied from two aspects of experiment and simulation. The results show that the steady-state current of the submarine cable is related to the influencing factors such as seawater temperature, laying depth and soil thermal conductivity, through simulation and experiments, it is concluded that the current of the submarine cable is negatively correlated with seawater temperature and laying depth, and positively correlated with the thermal conductivity of the soil. When the seawater temperature increases by 4 °C, the current of the submarine cable decreases by about 1 %, and the experiment result is lower than the simulation result; when the laying depth decreases by 0.2 m, the current of the submarine cable decreases by about 2 %, and the experimental result is about 3A lower than the simulation calculation result; When the soil thermal conductivity decreases by 0.1 W/km, the current of the submarine cable decreases by 7.2 %. Therefore, the soil thermal conductivity has the most significant impact on the current of the submarine cable; the transient current of submarine cable has great harm to the submarine cable, and the design of submarine cable is key considered; the experimental research and the finite element simulation analysis result are consistent, but there is a certain error, the error is within the correctable range, so the simulation can be used instead of the experiment. Research in this paper includes two parts of experiment and simulation, mutual proof, and can provide reference for future research.

articleTitle: Trend Analysis of Dissolved Gas in Oil for Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Transformer’s dissolved gas analysis(DGA) is a very important means of transformer condition maintenance. With the development of technology, more and more transformers have been installed with online DGA devices,but there is no standard to determine the abnormal gas generation rate of dissolved gas in on-line oil. In order to mine the information of transformer online monitoring data, this paper firstly classifies the changing trend of dissolved gas volume fraction in four kinds of oil after data filtering, which are respectively rising, fluctuating, stable and falling. Then on the quantity statistics found that smooth and growth trend is the main trend. Then counted the growth trend of generation rate of gas volume, using the weibull distribution function and the normal distribution function fitting after their generation rate distribution, the sub-point of distribution function is used as the basis to judge the abnormal gas generation rate. The results show that the threshold method determined by us is strict and has regional characteristics.

articleTitle: Research on Surface Discharge Direction Algorithm of Converter Valve Based on Ultraviolet Array Sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: To monitor the surface discharge with high sensitivity in the converter valve, the ultraviolet array sensor is designed. The propagation mode of ultraviolet signal of surface discharge of converter valve is analyzed by ray tracing method, and the direction algorithm of surface discharge based on phased array technology is proposed, and the noise space and signal subspace of 4-channel ultraviolet signal are extracted by rotating signal subspace algorithm. The positioning results of multiple surface discharges are simulated and analyzed, and the direction error is less than 1 degree, which provides a new algorithm for non-intrusive condition monitoring of converter valve.

articleTitle: Equivalence of DC Corona Loss Based on Small Corona Cages and Simplified Test Lines
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The direct current (DC) corona loss data obtained by using corona cages and test lines cannot be directly applied to actual DC transmission lines. In order to explore the equivalence of corona loss of conductors with different geometric structures, a test platform for DC corona discharge was built. In addition, the change law of corona loss of conductors with different geometric structures was investigated. The experimental results showed that the corona loss decreases with the increase of the radius of corona cages and the height of test lines above the ground. A generation function of corona loss containing only geometric parameters was defined. Based on the function, the equivalence of test data was studied and a method was obtained to translate the measurement data on the corona loss under one geometric structure to a variety of geometric structures.

articleTitle: The Effect of Paperboard Depression on Discharge under Positive and Negative DC Electric Field
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Partial discharge (PD) is considered to be the main reason for insulation aging and insulation failure. In order to research the PD characteristics of oil-paper insulation under DC electric field, the charge and PD under DC electric field was simulated based on two kinds of charge transport model, which used to simulate the discharge process in solid and liquid respectively. The image of discharge and space charge gained by the simulation were explained, and the affect of DC electric field polarity and paperboard depression on the partial discharge characteristics is analyzed. The conclusion of this paper is that PD development under DC voltage shows an obvious polarity effect, and the electric field at the depression is seriously distorted. The results above is conducive to the advancement of PD mechanism of oil-paper insulation.

articleTitle: Pattern Recognition of UHF Partial Discharge Signals in GIS Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The diagnosis of type of the ultra high frequency (UHF) partial discharge (PD) signals in gas insulated switchgear (GIS) can effectively prevent the occurrence of equipment failure. Firstly, a GIS basin-type insulator test platform is established to simulate the actual PD defect in GIS. Secondly, according to the characteristics of the UHF PD signals, the spectrogram is established, which characterizes its energy distribution on the time-frequency domain. Then, the dimensionality reduction and feature extraction are carried out by modified MFCCs (MMFCCs). Finally, the depth neural network model based on the gated recurrent unit (GRU) is established for PD type recognition. The results show that the model can effectively identify all kinds of PD defects of GIS in the laboratory conditions, and have a significant advantage over other machine learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Study on the Compatibility of Chloroprene Rubber and Environment-friendly Insulating Gas C5F10O
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: As an environmentally friendly insulation medium with the potential to replace SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>, research on C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf>O has been extensive conducted in recent years. Existing studies have confirmed that C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf>O mixtures has enough insulation strength to be used as the insulating gas for some gas insulated switchgear (GIS). However, the environmentally friendly GIE developed up to now still uses the same sealing materials as $\mathbf{S F}_{6}$ GIS. Whether these materials are compatible with C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf>O in the long term is still unknown, which limits the practical application of C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf>O in the future. Therefore, in this paper, the compatibility between C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf>O and chloroprene rubber, a commonly used sealing material in SF 6 GIE is studied through thermal accelerated aging method. The compression modulus was selected to evaluate the mechanical properties of CR during the four-week experiment. In addition, the changes in the the rubber surface under different aging conditions were analyzed by energy dispersive spectrometer, scanning electron microscopy and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. The results show that the compression modulus of CR treated in $\mathrm{C}_{5}\mathrm{~F}_{10}\mathrm{O}/\mathrm{N}_{2}$ is significantly lower than that of CR treated in N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. Moreover, after accelerated thermal aging, F elements were found on the aged rubber surface in the form of C-F bonds and metal fluorides, which indicates that C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf>O will react with CR in long-term coexistence. The incompatibility between C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf>O and CR needs to be considered in the design and manufacturing of C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf>O gas insulated electrical equipment.

articleTitle: A Method for Detecting DC Series Arc Faults in Photovoltaic System Based on FCM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: In this paper, combined with the time domain and frequency domain characteristic parameters of the arc fault current, the arc fault identification method based on the Fuzzy C-means (FCM) algorithm was studied. Taking the DC bus current simulated by the arc fault model as the research object, and extracting the time and frequency domain characteristic parameters of the arc fault current as the basic parameters of the FCM algorithm, the clustering of normal operation and arc fault was completed. The diagnosis of arc fault was realized by discriminating the position of the cluster center. MATLAB was used to verify the feasibility and anti-interference of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation of Voltage Transformer Based on Fault-Tree Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: This paper proposes a transformer operating state evaluation method based on fault tree analysis (FTA), which analyzes and counts various possible faults of the transformer, and classifies various basic fault events of the transformer through the establishment of a fault tree sorting, in order to find out the necessary conditions that affect the reliability of the transformer. While adopting the fault tree analysis method, the upstream method and the approximate calculation of the probability are used to analyze and calculate the known factors of the transformer, and the logically related or unrelated factors are summarized into several minimum cutset elements, and make these minimum cut-sets disjoint for easy calculation. The disjointness is convenient for calculation. Finally, the analysis and calculation of specific calculation examples are carried out based on the relevant data collected on site, and the probability and reliability of the transformer’s operating status are obtained. The calculation results can better reflect the actual operating state of the transformer.

articleTitle: Research on Arc Energy Release Characteristics of Live Working in Low-Voltage DC Distribution
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: When live working is implemented on 0.4 kV DC distribution equipment, it may occur electric arc accident due to accidental contact by operators. If safety protection is not in place, it may cause damage to the operators. In view of this, in order to find out the variation law of heat, sound and light energy release intensity of the live working arc in 0.4 kV DC distribution, this paper designs an arc energy release characteristic test. Then the relationship between arc heat release, measuring distance, duration and short-circuit current is obtained by using curve-fitting method. It provides the basis for the safety protection strategy of low-voltage operators. Furthermore, the hazard degree of heat energy, light intensity and sound pressure are comprehensively analyzed, and the corresponding protection methods are proposed.

articleTitle: Error Analysis of Extracting the Dielectric Spectroscopy of Oil-impregnated Paper from Oil-paper Insulation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Frequency Dielectric Spectroscopy (FDS) is a kind of dielectric response diagnostic method which is performed in frequency domain and is the most widely used transformer insulation detection. An important procedure in the insulation diagnostic is extracting the dielectric spectroscopy of oil-immersed paper from oil-paper insulation based on the XY model. As in the on-site measurement, the parameters of the structure used in the calculation are often estimated, which will bring error to the calculation of the spectroscopy of paper. In this paper, firstly the theory of the XY model and the calculation of the spectroscopy of paper are introduced. Two solutions of the calculated spectroscopy of paper are shown and the selection of the two solutions is discussed. Then a representation method called 3D-dielectric spectrum is proposed for the error analysis of the calculated spectroscopy of paper. And the influences of the related variables are studied. The conclusions show that the structural parameters of insulation X and Y have few influences on the error of the calculated spectroscopy of paper. And the error of the structural parameters $\Delta X$ and $\Delta Y$ influence differently at different frequency bands.

articleTitle: The Study On Reactor Fault Detection Based on Model Layering
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The dry-type air-core reactor is an indispensable power transmission and transformation equipment in the power system. Most of the fault diagnosis methods only diagnose the turn-to-turn short circuit faults of dry-type air-core reactors, and there is room for improvement in diagnostic sensitivity, practicability and accuracy. Based on the above problems, We propose a reactor fault perception method based on model layering, using convolutional neural networks to implement sub-model networks in the layered model, and realize the recognition of reactor fault types and the judgment of fault locations under different fault types. The results show that the method can effectively detect the fault type and fault location of the reactor.

articleTitle: Interfacial Bonding of Al-Si/C Composites and Improvement of the Thermal Shock Resistance
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The poor Carbon/Aluminum interfacial bonding and excessive difference in thermal expansion coefficients are the main factors for the performance failure of Carbon/Aluminum composites. C/Al-Si composites were prepared by pressure impregnation of carbon matrix with Al-Si alloys of different silicon element contents. The mechanism of the effect of silicon on improving the interfacial bonding, mechanical and electrical properties, and thermal shock resistance of the composites was investigated. The results showed that the mechanical strength and thermal shock resistance of the composites were proportional to the elemental silicon content, and the contact angle and porosity were inversely proportional to the mass fraction of silicon. When the mass fraction was 12 wt.%, the flexural strength was 1.49 times that of the unmodified composites and electrical conductivity of the composites were increased by 76.21% compared with the unmodified composites. The contact angle was reduced to 41°, and the flexural strength of the composites remained above 90% after thermal shock. This is because the generated silicon carbide layer formed between the interfaces can enhance the interfacial bonding, improve the impregnation rate, and reduce the thermal expansion difference, thus improving the overall performance of the C/Al-Si composites.

articleTitle: Research on The Lightning Performance of 500kV Composite Cross-arm Tower
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Nowadays, ultra-high voltage (UHV) transmission lines guarantee the stable supply of electric power. However, Lightning shielding failure is the main factor to threat the safety and reliability of UHV transmission lines. In order to assess the lightning resistance of composite UHV transmission towers, this paper compares the lightning resistance of composite cross-arm towers and steel cross-arm towers at the same conductor height based on typical electrical geometry model calculation principles, at the same time composite cross-arms with different tower heights and different protection angles are been analysed. The result shows that the lightning performance of composite cross-arm is basically the same as that of steel towers at the same conductor height. Because the tower height and protection angle can be reduced, the lightning resistance of composite cross-arms is better than that of steel towers.

articleTitle: Simulation of the Effect of Dielectric Match on Surface Flashover along Oil-Paper Insulation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: One of the weak points of oil-paper insulation in transformer insulation system is that a large number of interfaces formed by oil and oil-impregnated paperboard are prone to surface flashover. Among them, the dielectric match degree between oil and paperboard is one of the key factors affecting the development of flashover along the surface of oil-impregnated paperboard. Here, the match degree refers to the ratio between the dielectric constants of oil and oil-impregnated paperboard. The closer the ratio is to one, the higher their match degree is. The research shows that the lower the dielectric match degree between oil and paperboard, the lower the surface flashover voltage in the traditional needle-board structure. The traditional structure cannot completely simulate the structure of discharge along the surface, so the needle-board structure in which the needle tip is tangent to the paperboard at a certain angle is established. Change the dielectric constants of oil and paperboard and get seven different dielectric match degrees between 0.4–1. Simulate the electric field distribution of needle-plate electrode considering space charge, get the maximum electric field intensity on the three joints and the development of surface discharge, and analyze the relationship between them and the dielectric match degree. The three joints are the joint of oil, oil-impregnated paperboard and needle electrode. From the simulation results, it can be seen that the charge accumulation caused by electric field distortion weakens with the increase of dielectric match degree, then the charge density on the interface, the maximum electric field intensity and the length of streamer decreases. In practical application, the dielectric match degree is close to 0.5. Under this degree, the improvement of match degree in oil-paper insulation system can significantly increase the breakdown voltage of transformer oil, and improve the electrical performance of oil-paper insulation.

articleTitle: The Influence of Different Factors on Machine Learning Based Current Transformer Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The continuous construction of smart grid has put forward new requirements on the efficiency and accuracy of current measurement in all parts of the grid. In a previous study, a neural network-based algorithm for current transformers was proposed, which was applied to a circular magnetic field sensor array based on giant magnetoresistance effect (GMR). The essence of this algorithm is an inverse computation from magnetic field to current magnitude. The feasibility of this algorithm is verified under simplified conditions in previous study. In this article, we study the influence of the number of sensors, the inclination angle between current wire and the sensors plane, the wire’s eccentricity level, and the environmental noise on the accuracy of this algorithm, and then determine the feasibility of this algorithm in practical applications.

articleTitle: Analysis of Electric and Magnetic Field of ± 660kV HVDC OTL Underlying Human Body
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: ± 660 kV HVDC is Pakistan’s first-ever transmission line project. The transmission line is from Matiari to Lahore. The risk of lethal and harmful effects of Electric and magnetic fields from high voltage transmission lines on the human body and the living organisms in the vicinity is one of the most emerging and exciting subjects to study and analyze. The fundamental goal of this research is to calculate the static electric potential and static electric and magnetic field around and under the± 660kV HVDC transmission line in Pakistan. Calculation and analysis of electric and magnetic fields caused by DC high voltage overhead transmission lines in the presence of the human body are essential to determine the biophysical effects and to ensure public safety nearby the transmission line in Pakistan. The fundamental characteristics of this given field mainly depend upon the level of transmission voltage, current, and the position of transmission line conductors.

articleTitle: Heat and Moisture Coupling for HVAC Tunnel Cable
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The ampacity of tunnel cable is heavily dependent on the capacity to diffuse heat into surrounding air. This ability is significantly influenced by wet conditions. Based on the finite element method (FEM), a 3D model of high voltage alternating current (HVAC) tunnel cable is developed, coupling heat and moisture transfer. The thermal properties of air are changing with relative humidity and temperature. Latent heat of evaporation is included. Thermal analysis is conducted by recording the cable maximum temperature as a function of time and relative humidity. Temperature gradient exists not only radially, but also circumferentially and longitudinally.

articleTitle: Power Grid Practice of New Energy Participating in Primary Frequency Regulation in Power System with High Shares of Renewable and Power Electronics
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The proportion of new energy installed is increasing in the power system with high shares of renewable and power electronics, and conventional power sources are largely replaced. Therefore, the frequency regulation pressure and safe operation risk of power grid are increasing. Based on the rotor inertia control method and the pitch angle control participating in the frequency modulation method, the control logic of wind turbines participating in primary frequency regulation was realized in PSD-BPA. Taking the actual power grid as an example, the studies were carried out, that the function of wind turbine frequency regulation. The simulating results show that the frequency regulation control strategy can be realized in PSDBPA. When serious faults occur in power system, new energy frequency regulating function can play a significant role in improving stability.

articleTitle: Comparison of Water Adsorption Effect Between Zeolite 3A and 4A in Transformer Oil
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Transformer is the key equipment in power system. Moisture is an important factor affecting its insulation performance, which will have a great impact on the electrical and mechanical life of the transformer. Because of good performance of water absorption, zeolite 3A and 4A are most widely used in liquid drying. In this paper, water absorption capacity in transformer oil with zeolite 3A and 4A from two manufacturers are tested, absorption effect is compared. And dielectric properties of oil after moisture adsorption is tested. The results show that the water absorption of zeolite 4A is better than that of zeolite 3A, and the introduction of zeolite A will increase the breakdown voltage of oil.

articleTitle: The Comparison of Nodal Voltage Matrix and State Space Methods for Calculating the FRA Curve of the Transformer Winding
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: The study of the analysis and establishment of the equivalent circuit model of the transformer winding is a very important and essential approach in the area of condition monitoring of the power transformer. In this paper, two typical methods, which are nodal voltage matrix and state space methods, are elaborately introduced to set up the equivalent circuit model of the two-winding transformer winding with N discs to obtain the frequency response analysis (FRA) curves. Meanwhile, the accuracy of these two methods to compute the FRA results of the circuit model is validated by comparison with the FRA signature obtained by mature circuit simulation software. Finally, the calculation performance of the two methods is compared by computer time. The purpose of this paper is to provide a reference for the selection and using of these two approaches to obtain the FRA curve of the transformer winding.

articleTitle: Research on Characteristics of Creepage Discharge of Oil-paper Insulation in Natural ester Insulating Oil Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: In order to study the creepage characteristics of oil-paper insulation system in natural ester insulated oil transformer and provide the basis for insulation design of natural ester transformer, this paper carried out experimental research on the creepage characteristics of natural ester insulating oil-paper insulation with different moisture content and aging degrees. The results showed that with the increase of moisture content in oil, the creepage starting voltage, continuous discharge voltage and creepage appearance voltage of natural ester insulating oil-paper insulation decreased significantly, and there was no significant difference in creepage resistance time. The breakdown channel length and average creepage speed of natural ester insulating oil paper insulation had increased to a certain extent. The creepage characteristics in the direction perpendicular to the paperboard were slightly affected by the moisture content, but the creepage characteristics in the direction between the oil-paper insulation layers were greatly affected by the moisture content. There was no obvious difference in the creepage time and creepage starting voltage of aged paperboard and unaged paperboard. The creepage extinguishing voltage of the aged paperboard was slightly lower than that of the unaged paperboard. Aging had little effect on the insulation performance in the normal direction of the oil-paper insulation, but it reduced the creepage characteristics in the direction of the paperboard layer.

articleTitle: Difference Analysis of Vibration Characteristics in Different Structural Units of Gis Equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Abnormal mechanical vibration occurs frequently in the operation of Gas Insulator Switchgear (GIS), and its vibration characteristics are affected by many factors, which seriously endanger the safe and stable operation of the equipment. To master GIS equipment vibration characteristics in different structural unit, this paper took the GIS in a substation as the test object. First, aiming at bus, circuit breaker, disconnector, arrester, current transformer, voltage transformer and so on different structural unit in the same interval, we carried out the vibration test and analysis. Then the influence of voltage grade and phase on vibration was studied.Finally,the reasons of vibration difference were analyzed combining electromagnetic force, magnetostriction and equipment structure.The results show that the frequency of normal vibration signals in the gas chamber of 220 kV GIS equipment is mainly 100 Hz, and the vibration of bus chamber is the most intense.The vibration waveform of PT and arrester is seriously distorted and contains many frequency-doubling components.However, the vibration spectrum of 500 kV GIS equipment is more complicated.The research results can provide reference for defect diagnosis and status evaluation of GIS equipment.

articleTitle: DC Breakdown Properties and Mobility Characteristics of Different Insulation Liquids Applying in Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Transformer is a key component in power grid, and oil is still used widely as main insulating and cooling media because of its excellent property. Nowadays different kinds of oil get a lot of applications, including mineral oil, synthetic ester and natural ester, etc. HVDC systems and equipment require concrete information about dielectric property of insulating fluids under dc excitation. Therefore, it is vital to study the dielectric properties of dielectric liquids, and to understand their behaviour under both types of excitation. In this paper, DC breakdown voltage and apparent mobility of three kinds of oils were measured, and these results could give some reference to substitute traditional mineral oil in transformer.

articleTitle: An Anti Interference Technology of UHF PD Detection in UHV GIS Based on Automatic Time Difference Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: With the rapid development of ultra high voltage (UHV) power grid, the safety and stability of UHV gas insulated switchgear (GIS) is more and more important. The partial discharge (PD) detection technology is an effective way to find hidden PD trouble of UHV GIS equipment. However, there are many UHF detection instruments with different performance conditions, different on-site detection processes and discrimination standards, and the on-site detection environment of UHV substation is complex, which makes the interference signal in the detection process difficult to identify. In order to accurately locate the PD signal, the anti-interference problem must be solved first. This paper puts forward a principle of identifying interference signal method based on the anti-interference technology of automatic time difference analysis, which can effectively filter out external interference signal. The effectiveness of this method was also verified through laboratory research and field actual detection in this paper.

articleTitle: A Feature Extraction Method of GIS Optical Partial Dischage Signal Based on Multifractal Spectrums
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: This paper studied a feature extraction method of GIS optical partial discharge signal. This innovative method is based on multifractal spectrums, which improves from the fractal dimension. Different from the single fractal dimension, the multiple fractal spectrums describe the complexity and inhomogeneity of fractal with more details. In this paper, the fractal dimension and multifractal spectrums of GIS optical partial discharge signal were extracted, and then were recognized by back propagation neural network. By comparing the experimental results, it shows that the multi-fractal spectrum can characterize the optical partial discharge pattern of different insulation defects more effectively, and the classification accuracy is much higher than that of fractal dimension. The results show that the feature of multifractal spectral has great application value in the optical detection of insulation defect in GIS.

articleTitle: Characteristics of faluts of high voltage overhead transmission lines caused by icing in Zhejiang province
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Zhejiang province lies in the southeast coast of china with the geographical characteristics of mountains and hills. The overhead high voltage transmission lines are vulnerable to icing disaster which has great impact on safe and stable operation of power grid. The statistical analysis of the of transmission line ice accident is an important basis for the prevention of power grid icing disaster. In this paper, the transmission line ice accidents from Zhejiang province in the past ten years are systematically analyzed. The spatial-temporal features of the ice accidents were obtained. The meteorological characteristics of the ice accidents are presented. Besides, the influence of the altitude and the tower span is investigated. That is of great values for the forecast and mitigation of the high voltage overhead transmission lines’ ice accidents.

articleTitle: Continuous Arc Discharge Current Characteristics of Floating Conductor in AC Transmission Line Live Work
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: With the development of technology, advanced equipment with high-precision electronic equipment such as intelligent robots is increasingly used in live work. In live work of AC system, the continuous arc discharge generated by the floating potential conductor near the charged body is shown as a continuous high-frequency electromagnetic pulse. Although it has little impact on workers wearing shielding suits, it will cause obvious electromagnetic interference to precision electronic equipment. This paper analyzes the principles of arc discharge in floating conductors. Then taking the on-line process of a 500kV line live working robot as an example, an electromagnetic transient simulation model is established and the arc current is calculated and analyzed. The results show that the starting discharge position of the robot on-line process is about 10cm away from the wire, the arc current is a periodically spaced pulse waveform, a single pulse is a gradually decayed oscillating waveform, the wave head time is within 100ns, and the oscillation duration is around 1$\mu$s. As the discharge distance decreases, the energy of a single pulse decreases, but the pulse density increases, and the total average power increases. The calculation results can provide a reference for the electromagnetic protection of electronic equipment for live working in AC power transmission systems.

articleTitle: The Diagnosis Model of Line Loss Abnormity in Low-voltage Distribution Network Based on The Visualization Technology of Situation Awareness
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: This paper proposes a diagnosis model based on situation awareness for the diagnosis and analysis of the type of line loss anomalies in low-voltage distribution network (LVDN). First, sort out all the abnormal line loss causes, and divide them into 12 categories and 46 sub-categories; secondly, use situation awareness technology to generate situation base maps based on distribution network data, and use three-phase line loss calculations and situation base map rendering. After that, cluster analysis and mining of the abnormal situation map of the distribution network line loss, and obtain the abnormal situation map of the typical distribution network line loss, which is convenient for the subsequent rapid detection of the abnormal type of line loss; finally, build the abnormal line loss display of the distribution network based on the compass layout. The model is more conducive to system operators to clearly grasp the abnormal situation of the low-voltage distribution network. The effectiveness of the diagnostic model is verified by an example.

articleTitle: Failure Analysis of the Converter Valve in Gao-Zhao HVDC Project
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Several failures of high voltage direct current (HVDC) converter valve occurred in recent years. After carefully investigations, it was found that the thyristor voltage monitoring (TVM) board was responsible for many of them. In this paper, the working principle of TVM board is first introduced and a circuit simulation model is then built to carry out the simulation. After that, artificial contamination tests of TVM board are performed to verify the simulation. The results show that when the TVM board is seriously contaminated, the soluble salt components in the surface contamination layer can dissolve under high relative humidity conditions. This will reduce the equivalent balancing resistance which can result in check-back signals offset or even disappear. To crack this problem, regular cleaning is proposed to solve the TVM failure. This method has been successfully applied in Baoan converter station even the relative humidity is as high as 90%.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation and Experimental Analysis of Electromagnetic Pulse Welding Cable Joints
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Reliable connection between power cable and power equipment is related the safety of power system operation. In the conventional way, the welded cable connector may have a contact resistance that is too large in the later stage of use, which may cause a line fault. In order to avoid this situation, this paper proposes the use of electromagnetic pulse welding technology to weld the cable joints, and theoretically calculate the electromagnetic force, magnetic induction and other parameters required for the 70 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> distribution cable during the welding process, and then use PSpice. The simulation software such as COMSOL performs the specific analysis of the welding process, obtains the current and voltage values of the welding process and the simulation image of the deformation process, and finally carries out the experiment of cable joint welding. The theoretical calculation, simulation and experimental results of the various parameters of the welding process show that the theoretical calculation is similar to the simulation and experimental results, which provides a feasible basis for electromagnetic pulse welding cable joints.

articleTitle: Research on Steady and Polarity Reversal Electric Field of Converter Transformer Considering Nonlinear Temperature Coefficient of Oil-paper Insulation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Converter transformer suffers from AC/DC composite voltage, and the internal insulation system has high temperature during operation. the electrical conductivity of the oil-paper insulation will be affected by the temperature gradient, which ultimately affects the electric field distribution. The study in consideration of nonlinear temperature coefficient is still not sufficient. This paper established a converter transformer coupling calculation model and analyzed the steady and polarity reversal electric fields under the influence of temperature. The electric field considering the nonlinear temperature coefficient was compared with that obtained by the traditional method. The results show that, the maximum electric field in oil increased by 84.9% in the steady state. The maximum tangential electric field along the oil-paper interface nearly doubled. During polarity reversal, the maximum electric field decreased, and the electric field change rate became faster.

articleTitle: Surface Charge Dynamic Behaviors of Epoxy/BN Composite with High Thermal Conductivity
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: In order to solve the temperature rise problem of GIL basin insulator and prolong the service life of gas-insulated metal-enclosed transmission line (GIL), the surface charge dynamics of epoxy / boron nitride (BN) composite materials with high thermal conductivity with different cooling time after DC corona are investigated. In this paper, using a corona discharge system, epoxy resin specimens were charged and the charge dissipation processes were measured with an electrostatic voltmeter. It is found that at the same temperature, the surface charge dissipation rate of the sample decreases first and then increases with the increase of the nanoparticle content of the sample, while the initial surface charge density increases first and then decreases. For the same sample, as the cooling time increases, the surface charge dissipation slows down but the initial surface charge density increases.

articleTitle: A Novel HVDC Converter for Reducing Commutation Failure Probability
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: In this paper, a new structure of HVDC transmission system is proposed. Only inductors and capacitors are added to the conventional DC transmission system. Firstly, the special commutation process of the new system is analyzed, and the quasi steady state model of HVDC transmission is established. Then, the different calculation methods of extinction angle between the new system and the original system are analyzed, and the principle that the new system can reduce the commutation failure probability is analyzed. Then, the functions of the newly added inductor and capacitor are analyzed. Finally, the effectiveness of the new system in reducing commutation failure probability is verified by simulation and comparison with conventional HVDC transmission.

articleTitle: The effect of metal wires on vacuum flashover
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Advanced Electrical Equipment and Reliable Operation (AEERO)
abstract: Surface flashover in vacuum is a kind of low-pressure plasma discharge, which seriously restricts the development of various areas, including pulsed-power devices, particle accelerators and other vacuum electronic devices. In this paper, the influence of silver wires on vacuum flashover is well studied with simulation and experiment. For getting the more accurate electric field, the finite element analysis software COMSOL is employed to simulate the surface electric field distribution with the presence of silver wires. It’s found that the silver wires increase the electric field at the metal-surface-vacuum junction and slightly decrease it at the cathode triple junction (CTJ). A particle-in-cell (PIC) simulation model is constructed to investigate the impact of silver wires on the flashover process. In order to estimate the influence of silver wires, three factors are analyzed, including the electrons distribution, average surface charge density and anode current. It can be observed that the metal wires suppress the surface charge accumulation and the development of multipactor, thus enhance the surface performance. The parameters of metal wires, for instance the width and number of wires, also make a difference. In the end, some experimental results are provided, which are consistent with the simulation results.
